character_v1.name: Gum

abilities.name: Basic Attack
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling
Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction
mechanics: Ranged single strike.
Scales with ATK.
abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Light.

abilities.name: Tag Turf
abilities.description: Gum's signature passive ability. Whenever Gum uses an ability that involves spraying graffiti, she creates a 'Tag Turf' zone at the target location. These zones last for 8 seconds. If Gum is within a Tag Turf zone created by her, she gains 15% increased movement speed and her next basic attack deals 20% bonus magic damage. If an enemy is within Gum's Tag Turf zone, their movement speed is reduced by 10% and they take 10 magic damage per second. Multiple Tag Turf zones can be active simultaneously, but their effects do not stack. Overlapping Tag Turf zones simply refresh the duration of the effect in the overlapping area. Prioritizes most recent tag.
abilities.flavorQuote: This is MY turf now, punk!

abilities.name: Graffiti Boost
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Gum dashes forward a short distance, spraying a trail of graffiti behind her. The dash covers a fixed distance and cannot be interrupted. Enemies caught in the trail take 40 magic damage and are slowed by 25% for 2 seconds. This ability creates a Tag Turf zone along the entire length of the graffiti trail. The Tag Turf will be applied for the full duration as described in her passive Tag Turf, creating zones that Gum can utilize for her own benefits. Cooldown: 10 seconds. Activating this ability refreshes the duration of any existing Tag Turf zones Gum is currently standing in.
abilities.flavorQuote: Catch me if you can!

abilities.name: Spray Tag
abilities.description: Gum throws a spray can at a target location. Upon impact, the spray can explodes in a burst of paint, dealing 60 magic damage to enemies within a small radius and creating a Tag Turf zone. The Tag Turf zone from this ability is slightly larger than those created by other abilities. Additionally, enemies hit by the initial spray can explosion are marked for 4 seconds, causing them to take 15% increased magic damage from all sources. Cooldown: 12 seconds. This ability serves as Gum's primary method for engaging enemies while enabling her to mark high-priority targets.
abilities.flavorQuote: Express delivery!

abilities.name: Grind Rail
upgrades: (Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~32%).
abilities.description: Gum creates a temporary grind rail in a straight line from her current location for 6 seconds. Gum and allied champions can grind along the rail, gaining 30% increased movement speed and immunity to slows while grinding. Enemies that attempt to cross the rail are knocked back a short distance and take 30 magic damage. The beginning and end points of the grind rail are marked with Tag Turf zones that last the full duration of the ability. Cooldown: 15 seconds. Can be used defensively to escape or offensively to engage.
abilities.flavorQuote: Time to ride!

abilities.name: Art Attack
abilities.description: Gum unleashes a massive graffiti storm in a large target area. Over 4 seconds, multiple spray cans fall from the sky, dealing 30 magic damage to enemies per hit and creating numerous overlapping Tag Turf zones across the entire area. Enemies caught in the Art Attack are also silenced for 1 second each time they are hit by a spray can. The entire area becomes heavily saturated with Tag Turf, granting Gum significant advantages if she remains within the zone. Cooldown: 90 seconds. This ability allows Gum to heavily control a zone, punishing enemies who remain within its radius.
abilities.flavorQuote: Let's paint the town!

character_v1.playstyle: Mobile Zone Control
character_v1.teamSynergy: Gum excels in teams that can capitalize on her zone control and target marking abilities. Allies with strong burst damage or area of effect abilities can benefit from Gum's ability to mark targets and create advantageous zones. She is also effective in compositions that prioritize objective control, as she can use her abilities to secure and defend key areas.
character_v1.tierSummary: Gum's viability hinges on maximizing Tag Turf for consistent zoning and speed advantages; however, her effectiveness diminishes against hyper-mobile characters and teams with strong anti-projectile tools. While Grind Rail offers unique mobility and displacement, its linear nature makes it predictable, limiting outplay potential. Spray Tag's burst damage combined with Graffiti Boost offers kill confirms, but inconsistent area denial puts Gum at a disadvantage compared to peers like Kazeto Nekoshima, whose zone control is less telegraphed. Art Attack provides clutch silences and prolonged zone control but the cast time leaves her vulnerable to interrupts, undermining its utility against higher-tier characters.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Gum's abilities synergize around the Tag Turf mechanic, allowing her to create zones that enhance her mobility and damage while hindering enemies. Graffiti Boost and Spray Tag are her primary tools for creating Tag Turf zones, while Grind Rail provides a mobile escape or engage option. Art Attack serves as a powerful zoning tool that can heavily control a large area.

character_v1.name: Beat

abilities.name: Basic Attack
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling
Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction
mechanics: Ranged single strike.
Scales with ATK.
abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Light.

abilities.name: Tag Frenzy (Signature Passive)
abilities.description: Beat gains 'Tag Frenzy' stacks by skating a certain distance (approximately the length of 2 standard dashes) and successfully applying graffiti with his abilities. Each Tag Frenzy stack increases Beat's movement speed by 1% and the potency of his buffs by 0.5%, stacking up to 20 times. When Beat reaches the maximum stacks of Tag Frenzy, his next cast of 'Graffiti Zone' will also apply a 2 second stun to enemies inside the zone upon creation. Stacks decay by 1 every 3 seconds when not actively gaining new stacks. This passive emphasizes Beat's need to maintain momentum and aggression in controlling the battlefield.
abilities.flavorQuote: Gotta keep movin', gotta keep taggin'!

abilities.name: Graffiti Zone
abilities.description: Beat deploys a circular zone of graffiti at a targeted location with a radius roughly the size of two character models. Enemies inside the zone have their movement speed reduced by 20% and their attack damage reduced by 10%. Allies inside the zone gain 10% increased movement speed. The zone lasts for 5 seconds. At max Tag Frenzy stacks, enemies are stunned for 2 seconds upon zone creation. Using this ability grants 3 Tag Frenzy stacks. The zone's effects pulse every second, reapplying the debuffs/buffs. Cooldown of 12 seconds. The range is medium, requiring Beat to position himself strategically to control key areas.
abilities.flavorQuote: This turf's been claimed!

abilities.name: Rolling Boost
abilities.description: Beat performs a quick dash in a target direction, gaining temporary invulnerability for 0.5 seconds during the dash. Upon completion of the dash, Beat leaves a short trail of graffiti behind him, lasting for 2 seconds. Allies that pass through the trail gain a 15% speed boost for 1.5 seconds. Enemies that pass through the trail are slowed by 25% for 1 second. This ability is crucial for both engaging/disengaging and setting up strategic plays. Using this ability grants 2 Tag Frenzy stacks. Cooldown of 8 seconds. The dash distance is roughly the length of 3 character models.
abilities.flavorQuote: Catch me if you can!

abilities.name: Rhythmic Flow
abilities.description: Beat passively grants nearby allies (within a radius of 2 character models) 5% increased magic resistance. Additionally, for every 5 'Tag Frenzy' stacks Beat has, this passive effect is amplified, granting an additional 1% magic resistance to allies, stacking up to a maximum of 9% magic resistance at full stacks. This passive encourages Beat to stick with his team, providing a constant aura of magic protection that scales with his Tag Frenzy. The bonus magic resistance is a significant boon against magic-heavy compositions, making Beat a valuable asset in team fights.
abilities.flavorQuote: Feel the beat, feel the flow!

abilities.name: Grand Finale (Ultimate)
upgrades: Empowered Hues: Increases the attack speed buff granted to allies by 10%.
abilities.description: Beat throws down his ultimate masterpiece, a swirling vortex of graffiti that covers a wide area. The area is a 60-degree cone extending 5 character model lengths in front of him. Enemies caught within this vibrant explosion are instantly silenced, their voices and abilities muted for a full 2 seconds as the paint coats their mouths and mechanisms. Simultaneously, they suffer X magic damage spread over 3 seconds as the corrosive pigments eat away at their armor and energy. Allies basking in the radiant glow of Beat's art are invigorated, their attack speed surging by 20% for 4 glorious seconds. Furthermore, should Beat possess maximum 'Tag Frenzy' stacks upon unleashing his Grand Finale, the silence inflicted upon his foes intensifies, stretching to a debilitating 3 seconds. But the benefits do not stop there! Allies are not only empowered with increased attack speed, but also healed for X health points over the same 4 seconds, the regenerative properties of the paint mending their wounds and restoring their vigor. This ability serves as Beat's signature move, a stunning display of artistic power that can turn the tide of battle in a heartbeat, whether engaging in a daring offensive or repelling a fearsome assault.

character_v1.playstyle: Mobile Area Denial Support
character_v1.teamSynergy: Beat synergizes well with mobile, aggressive teams who can capitalize on the movement speed buffs and make use of the area control provided by 'Graffiti Zone'. His ultimate provides a powerful engage or counter-engage tool for coordinated teams.
character_v1.tierSummary: Beat's support role is marred by kit fragmentation; while *Rhythmic Flow* provides passive magic resist and *Graffiti Zone* offers area control, their limited impact fails to justify his 'A' tier. *Tag Frenzy* and *Rolling Boost* offer mobility but lack direct team utility, resulting in disjointed synergy compared to peer supports. The ultimate, *Art Attack*, offers both control and healing, but its cone-shaped area is too restrictive to reliably land in chaotic team fights. Beat’s viability hinges on maximizing uptime on *Graffiti Zone* and landing clutch *Art Attacks*; however, his kit is outshined by more cohesive support options within the current roster population.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Beat's kit revolves around maintaining 'Tag Frenzy' stacks. 'Rolling Boost' and 'Graffiti Zone' allow for quick stack generation. The passive amplify magic resistance based on his stacks, rewarding aggressive play.

character_v1.name: Dj Professor K

abilities.name: Basic Attack
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling
Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction
mechanics: Melee single strike.
Scales with ATK.
abilities.description: Melee basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Wind.

abilities.name: Mic Check
abilities.description: DJ Professor K projects a sonic wave in a targeted direction, affecting all enemies in a line. This ability applies 'Static' to enemies hit. Static reduces enemy speed by 15% and attack by 10% for 3 seconds. If Mic Check is activated at the 'Drop' of any Airwaves, it also inflicts 'Silence' for 1.5 seconds, preventing affected enemies from casting abilities. Successfully timing Mic Check at the 'Drop' also grants Professor K a 20% boost to his magic attack for 5 seconds, amplifying the power of his subsequent abilities and enhancing his control over the battlefield, making enemies vulnerable to allies and hindering their offensive capabilities.
abilities.flavorQuote: Can you hear me now? Good.

abilities.name: Soulful Beat
abilities.description: Professor K lays down a 'Soulful Beat' at a targeted location, creating a zone that pulses with energy for 5 seconds. Allies within the zone gain a 10% increase to their attack speed and a 15% increase to their movement speed. This zone generates 'Airwaves' every second. If an ally activates an ability within the zone, the 'Airwaves' immediately reach their 'Drop', granting that ally a shield that absorbs damage equal to 10% of their maximum health for 2 seconds. The strategic placement of this zone can significantly boost ally performance, turning the tide of battles by enhancing their mobility and offensive capabilities while offering a layer of protection through precisely timed ability activations.
abilities.flavorQuote: Feel the rhythm, feel the ride!

abilities.name: Rewind Selecta
abilities.description: DJ Professor K manipulates the flow of battle by 'Rewinding' a selected ally, resetting the cooldown of one of their abilities (excluding Ultimates) to enhance their strategic flexibility. This ability also generates 'Airwaves'. If 'Rewind Selecta' is used on an ally at the 'Drop', it also heals them for 5% of their maximum health and reduces incoming damage by 10% for 3 seconds. This provides an added layer of support and survivability, making Professor K a crucial asset in prolonged engagements. Skillful timing of this ability is crucial for maximizing its benefits, offering both strategic advantage and immediate aid to allies in need.
abilities.flavorQuote: Let's take it from the top!

abilities.name: Sonic Boombox
upgrades: Echo Chamber: Extends the duration of the critical hit chance buff to 9 seconds, amplifying the rhythmic surge to even greater heights.
abilities.description: DJ Professor K drops the beat with 'Sonic Boombox', unleashing a monumental wave of sound that reverberates across the entire battlefield. As the track hits its crescendo, allies find themselves invigorated by the rhythm; their attacks gain a ferocious edge, increasing damage dealt by 25% and amplifying their chances of landing critical hits by 15% for a full 7 seconds. Simultaneously, enemies caught in the sonic crossfire are overwhelmed by the sheer force of the music. Their carefully aimed assaults become clumsy, suffering a 20% accuracy reduction, and their arcane defenses crumble, enduring a 10% reduction in magic resistance for the same debilitating 7 seconds. But the true power of 'Sonic Boombox' lies in its peak. At the 'Drop,' the sound wave intensifies, shielding allies from all forms of crowd control for a crucial 1 second, rendering them impervious to stuns, snares, and other disabling effects. This momentary invulnerability allows them to unleash their full potential without interruption. Furthermore, the force of the drop hits enemies like a physical blow, instantly stunning all foes caught within the blast radius for 1 second, halting their movements and plans in their tracks. 'Sonic Boombox' doesn't just shift the balance; it completely rewrites the rules of engagement, forging a decisive moment where overwhelming victory becomes not just possible, but inevitable.

abilities.name: Guerrilla Tactics
abilities.description: DJ Professor K's presence on the battlefield generates 'Airwaves' passively over time, which visually pulse around him. When Professor K uses an active ability, it consumes all current 'Airwaves' to amplify the effect of the ability, based on how close the activation was to the 'Drop' of the Airwaves cycle. The closer the activation is to the 'Drop', the greater the effect. Additionally, every 10 seconds, Professor K gains a stack of 'Inspiration', up to a maximum of 3 stacks. Consuming a stack of 'Inspiration' with an ability grants him 10% Lifesteal for 3 seconds, increasing his survivability during crucial moments in combat.
abilities.flavorQuote: Keep the beat alive!

character_v1.playstyle: Rhythmic Buffer/Debuffer
character_v1.teamSynergy: DJ Professor K excels in teams that can capitalize on his buffs and debuffs. High-damage carries benefit from 'Rude Awakening's' damage increase, while 'Rewind Selecta' can be used to reset cooldowns of key support abilities or to give damage dealers more opportunities to unleash powerful attacks. He synergizes well with characters that have high-impact abilities with long cooldowns, or with those that thrive in sustained engagements, as his Lifesteal from 'Guerrilla Tactics' and shield through 'Soulful Beat' can provide them with added survivability.
character_v1.tierSummary: DJ Professor K's S-tier placement hinges on the oppressive synergy of 'Mic Check' (AoE silence/debuff) and 'Soulful Beat' (buff zone), creating inescapable control zones that enable allies; 'Rewind Selecta' further amplifies this advantage, circumventing cooldown weaknesses and bolstering burst windows. Compared to other S-tier controllers, K sacrifices direct damage for unparalleled buff uptime and zone control, making him vulnerable to hyper-aggressive divers without sufficient team coordination, but extremely potent when properly protected. 'Rude Awakening' provides crucial global pressure and crowd control, though its reliance on 'Airwaves' management adds a layer of complexity not always rewarded in chaotic matchups. While characters like Valentino offer more potent single-target lockdowns, Professor K's area denial and team-wide utility provide superior battlefield dominance in organized play, justifying his tier placement.
character_v1.internalSynergy: DJ Professor K's abilities revolve around the strategic use of 'Airwaves', rewarding precise timing for maximum impact. His passive, 'Guerrilla Tactics', encourages players to attentively manage their ability activations in sync with the 'Airwave' cycle, amplifying their effects and synergizing with his active skills. 'Soulful Beat' and 'Rewind Selecta' can set up allies for powerful plays, while 'Mic Check' debilitates enemies. 'Rude Awakening' amplifies the benefits of correct Airwave management to create impactful windows of opportunity for the entire team.

character_v1.name: Marle

abilities.name: Basic Attack
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling
Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction
mechanics: Melee single strike.
Scales with ATK.
abilities.description: Melee basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Fire.

abilities.name: Chrono Shift
upgrades: (Patch) Role realignment: This ability now emphasizes utility-style interactions, increasing shield uptime and buff potential.
abilities.description: Marle manipulates the flow of time around an ally, mending their wounds and warding them against future harm. A surge of temporal energy washes over the chosen companion, instantly restoring health equal to 80% of Marle's Magic Attack. The Chrono Shift extends its protection further if Marle has recently exploited the Paradoxical Shot, a state achieved by freezing an opponent. If Paradoxical Shot is active, the healing potency increases by a significant 30% of the base value, and additionally, conjures a shimmering temporal shield. This shield mitigates damage equivalent to 60% of Marle's Magic Attack and lasts for 3 seconds, consuming the Paradoxical Shot buff. Should the targeted ally's health be already at its peak, the Chrono Shift transforms the healing into a temporary temporal Overheal, creating a shield that absorbs up to 50% of the initial healing amount. This Overheal shield gradually fades, decaying completely after 3 seconds. Moreover, the act of successfully healing a comrade with Chrono Shift re-activates the Paradoxical Shot, charging Marle's next crossbow bolt with frost, setting her up to potentially freeze another enemy combatant.

abilities.name: Ice Bolt
abilities.description: Marle fires a bolt of ice at a target enemy, dealing X magic damage. If Paradoxical Shot is active from healing an ally, Ice Bolt instantly freezes the target for 1.5 seconds. Otherwise, Ice Bolt has a 30% chance to freeze the target for 1 second. This consumes the Paradoxical Shot buff, if any. Damage is affected by magic attack. The freeze duration is reduced by tenacity. If Ice Bolt freezes an enemy, Marle's next Aura Shot is amplified.
abilities.flavorQuote: Chill out, literally!

abilities.name: Haste
abilities.description: Marle casts a spell on a target ally, granting them X% increased speed and attack speed for 5 seconds. If Paradoxical Shot is active, the duration is extended to 7 seconds. After Haste expires, the target ally gains a burst of healing for X HP. This ability can be cast on herself. Casting Haste triggers Paradoxical Shot, readying Marle's next crossbow attack to freeze.
abilities.flavorQuote: Time is of the essence, let's pick up the pace!

abilities.name: Royal Decree
abilities.description: Marle calls upon her royal lineage, creating a zone of healing and slowing. For 6 seconds, allies within the zone heal for X HP every second and gain 20% increased tenacity. Enemies within the zone are slowed by 30%. If Marle has Paradoxical Shot active before casting Royal Decree, the healing is amplified by 40% or the slow is increased to 50%. This consumes the Paradoxical Shot buff, if any. The zone's size is significantly larger than her normal abilities. The healing is affected by magic attack.
abilities.flavorQuote: By the power vested in me, I command you to heal!

abilities.name: Temporal Paradox
abilities.description: After healing or buffing an ally, Marle gains Paradoxical Shot, causing her next crossbow attack to freeze the target for 1 second. After freezing an enemy, Marle also gains Paradoxical Shot, causing her next heal to be amplified by 20%. Paradoxical Shot lasts for 5 seconds. If a new Paradoxical Shot is obtained before the previous one is used, the duration resets. This passive encourages a rotation of healing/buffing and attacking.
abilities.flavorQuote: A twist of fate, a ripple in time.

character_v1.playstyle: Ranged support with healing and crowd control, using Paradoxical Shot to enhance either damage or healing.
character_v1.teamSynergy: Marle excels in teams that benefit from sustained healing, speed buffs, and crowd control. She pairs well with damage dealers who can capitalize on frozen enemies. Her healing and speed buffs enhance the survivability and damage output of her allies. She is especially potent with aggressive melee carries who need the extra speed to chase down opponents and the freeze to secure kills.
character_v1.tierSummary: Marle's viability as an 'A' tier Support Marksman hinges on the inconsistent application of Paradoxical Shot, offering conditional but potent heal/damage flips; compared to the overloaded support meta, her single-target healing is inefficient, demanding precise timing for burst value. While Royal Decree provides niche AoE utility, its effectiveness is highly dependent on team positioning, and her Haste buff is a middling contribution in a meta saturated with superior speed enhancers. The kit's synergy is marred by reliance on Paradoxical Shot procs, rendering her performance unreliable against more consistent A-tier peers, thus making her a situational pick requiring exceptional execution to warrant her inclusion.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Marle's kit revolves around the Paradoxical Shot mechanic, encouraging her to alternate between healing/buffing allies and attacking enemies. Aura Shot and Haste trigger Paradoxical Shot, setting up Ice Bolt for a freeze. Ice Bolt, if successful, empowers her next Aura Shot. Royal Decree benefits from Paradoxical Shot, amplifying either its healing or slowing capabilities.

character_v1.name: Lucca

abilities.name: Basic Attack
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling
Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction
mechanics: Ranged single strike.
Scales with ATK.
abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Fire.

abilities.name: Flame Grenade
abilities.description: Lucca hurls a Flame Grenade at the target location, consuming 1 Gadget Charge. Upon impact, the grenade explodes, dealing 80 + (0.6 * Magic Attack) Fire damage to enemies within a 2-meter radius. If Lucca has 3 Gadget Charges, the explosion also leaves behind a patch of burning ground for 3 seconds, dealing 20 + (0.1 * Magic Attack) Fire damage per second to enemies who stand within the affected area. The burning ground expands to a 3-meter radius. This ability has a 8-second cooldown.
abilities.flavorQuote: Time for a little combustion therapy!

abilities.name: Robo Beacon
abilities.description: Lucca deploys a Robo Beacon, consuming 1 Gadget Charge. The beacon provides a 4-meter radius aura that grants allies within it 15% increased Attack Speed and 10% increased Movement Speed. If Lucca has 3 Gadget Charges, the beacon will also emit a pulse every 3 seconds, healing allies within the aura for 30 + (0.2 * Magic Attack) HP. The beacon lasts for 10 seconds or until destroyed. The Robo Beacon has 150 HP. This ability has a 12-second cooldown.
abilities.flavorQuote: Robo's got your back... indirectly!

abilities.name: Emergency Barrier
abilities.description: Lucca activates an Emergency Barrier on herself or an ally, consuming 1 Gadget Charge. The barrier absorbs 100 + (0.4 * Magic Attack) damage. If the barrier is broken or expires after 5 seconds, it releases a small explosion, knocking back nearby enemies a short distance and dealing 40 + (0.3 * Magic Attack) magic damage. If Lucca has 3 Gadget Charges, the barrier's duration increases to 8 seconds and the knockback distance is significantly increased. This ability has a 15-second cooldown.
abilities.flavorQuote: Don't worry, I've got a shield for that!

abilities.name: Telepod Trap
abilities.description: Lucca creates a Telepod Trap at the target location. This trap remains stealthed until an enemy steps within a 2.5-meter radius. Upon activation, the trap teleports all enemies within the radius to a designated location within a 6-meter range (determined by Lucca upon placement). After teleportation, the trap detonates, dealing 150 + (1.0 * Magic Attack) Fire damage to all enemies in the teleport destination. The destination area also has a 40% slow for 2 seconds. The trap lasts for up to 20 seconds if not triggered. This ability has a 70-second cooldown.
abilities.flavorQuote: Oops, wrong destination!

abilities.name: Gadgeteer's Intuition
abilities.description: Lucca passively generates 1 Gadget Charge every 20 seconds, up to a maximum of 3. Using an ability consumes a Gadget Charge. Additionally, Lucca gains 5% increased Magic Attack for each Gadget Charge she possesses, up to a maximum of 15% at full charges. If Lucca is below 25% health, she regenerates Gadget Charges twice as fast. This encourages strategic ability usage and rewards resource management. This passive fuels Lucca's inventive playstyle and ensures her gadgets are always ready when needed.
abilities.flavorQuote: Invention is 1% inspiration, 99% tinkering... and a little bit of pyrotechnics!

character_v1.playstyle: Zone Control, Gadget Placement, Ranged Damage
character_v1.teamSynergy: Lucca synergizes well with damage-dealing allies who can capitalize on her zone control and buffs. Her Robo Beacon provides valuable support to melee fighters, while Telepod Trap can isolate key targets for assassins or create opportunities for AoE damage dealers. She also benefits from tanky allies who can protect her while she sets up her gadgets.
character_v1.tierSummary: Lucca's S-tier placement is justified by her Gadget Charge-fueled kit, offering sustained AOE damage (Flame Grenade) and support (Robo Beacon, Emergency Barrier). Her Telepod Trap ultimate provides critical zone control, outperforming most support peers in disruption potential, but relies heavily on proper placement. The core synergy lies in managing Gadget Charges for consistent output, scaling magic attack with *Gadgeteer's Intuition*, enabling both offensive and defensive plays. Compared to other S-tiers, Lucca trades burst potential for sustained utility, making her a strong, but not overwhelming, pick.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Lucca's abilities work together to control zones, protect allies, and burst down enemies. The Gadget Charge mechanic encourages strategic ability use and rewards resource management. Flame Grenade can create persistent damage zones, Robo Beacon provides consistent buffs and healing, and Emergency Barrier offers protection and disruption. Telepod Trap is a powerful ultimate for initiating fights or punishing enemy positioning.

character_v1.name: Ralph

abilities.name: Basic Attack
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling
Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction
mechanics: Ranged single strike.
Scales with ATK.
abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Electric.

abilities.name: Wrecking Ball
abilities.description: Ralph charges forward a short distance, dealing 80 + (0.5 * ATK) physical damage and knocking back all enemies in his path. If Ralph collides with a wall or terrain obstacle, he creates 'Wreckage', stunning nearby enemies for 0.75 seconds and gaining 10 Wreckage. 'Wreckage' is the essence of Ralph's destructive power, fueling his abilities and fortifying his presence on the battlefield. The distance traveled by Ralph increases slightly based on his current movement speed, allowing for strategic initiations and escapes. The stun duration is reduced by 30% against enemies who have been recently stunned by this ability or 'Here Comes the Pain!'
abilities.flavorQuote: "I'm gonna WRECK IT!"

abilities.name: Here Comes the Pain!
abilities.description: Ralph slams his fists into the ground, creating a shockwave that deals 60 + (0.3 * ATK) physical damage to nearby enemies and slows them by 25% for 2 seconds. For every 20 Wreckage Ralph possesses, the range and damage of this ability increase by 10%. Additionally, if Ralph has 80 or more Wreckage, enemies hit by this ability are also stunned for 0.5 seconds. The Wreckage is then consumed. This ability is key to controlling the immediate area around Ralph, forcing enemies to respect his personal space. Strategic use of Wrecking Ball ensures the empowered effect of 'Here Comes the Pain!'
abilities.flavorQuote: "Hope you brought a bucket!"

abilities.name: Bad Guy Recognition
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Ralph's basic attacks deal an additional 20 + (0.1 * ATK) physical damage. For every 10 Wreckage Ralph possesses, his basic attacks also gain 5% lifesteal. When Ralph reaches 100 Wreckage, his next basic attack consumes all Wreckage to create a temporary terrain obstacle (a pile of bricks) at the target location. This pile of bricks lasts for 5 seconds and blocks enemy movement. It has 200 health and can be destroyed. The created obstacle strategically blocks paths and protects allies. This passive rewards aggression and the generation of Wreckage, emphasizing Ralph's role as a disruptive tank.
abilities.flavorQuote: "I'm bad, and that's good!"

abilities.name: Wreck-It!
abilities.description: Ralph channels for 1 second, becoming unstoppable and gaining a shield equal to 15% of his max HP for 4 seconds. Upon completion of the channel, Ralph unleashes a powerful punch in a target direction, dealing 120 + (0.7 * ATK) physical damage to all enemies in a line. The width of the punch increases by 20% for every 30 Wreckage Ralph has, up to a maximum of 60%. This ability serves as both a defensive tool (with the shield and unstoppable effect) and an offensive powerhouse. This is useful for punishing grouped-up enemies or disrupting key targets in a team fight. Ralph gains 20 Wreckage on cast.
abilities.flavorQuote: "I'm gonna wreck it... for real this time!"

abilities.name: Stump Fortification
abilities.description: Ralph summons his beloved stump to a target location. The stump provides a large area of defensive terrain lasting for 8 seconds. Allies within the stump's radius gain 30 armor and magic resistance. Enemies within the stump's radius are slowed by 20% and take 30 + (0.15 * ATK) physical damage per second. When the stump disappears, Ralph gains 5 Wreckage per nearby allied champion. The stump has 500 health. The health of the stump scales with Ralph's max HP. The strategic placement of the stump is crucial for controlling objectives or defending vulnerable allies. This ability solidifies Ralph's role as a territorial tank, creating a safe haven for his team while punishing enemies who dare to trespass.
abilities.flavorQuote: "This is MY stump!"

character_v1.playstyle: Disruptive, Territorial, Aggressive
character_v1.teamSynergy: Ralph synergizes well with teams that benefit from strong frontlines and area denial. Carries who need protection will appreciate the defensive terrain provided by 'Stump Fortification' and the disruption offered by 'Wrecking Ball' and brick walls. Mages who excel in sustained damage will benefit from enemies being slowed within the Stump's radius, and stunned via Here Comes The Pain!
character_v1.tierSummary: Ralph's A-Tier status hinges on his Wreckage-dependent sustain and terrain control, but he struggles to compete with dedicated tanks or damage dealers. While 'Bad Guy Recognition' offers potent lifesteal scaling and 'Stump Fortification' provides significant team utility, his reliance on Wreckage and moderate base stats render him easily counterable by anti-healing or terrain disruption. 'Wrecking Ball' into 'Here Comes the Pain!' provides decent disruption, but its limited range and predictable nature is often insufficient against higher-tier mobile damage characters. Compared to other A-tier tanks, Ralph lacks the raw mitigation or impactful crowd control to consistently anchor a team, relegating him to a niche pick in specific team compositions.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Ralph's kit revolves around generating and utilizing Wreckage. 'Wrecking Ball' provides initiation and Wreckage generation, which then empowers 'Here Comes the Pain!' and Ralph's basic attacks via 'Bad Guy Recognition'. 'Wreck-It!' offers a defensive option while still contributing to Wreckage buildup. 'Stump Fortification' provides strong territorial control and utility for the team, further solidifying Ralph's role.

character_v1.name: Kazeto Nekoshima

abilities.name: Basic Attack
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling
Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction
mechanics: Ranged single strike.
Scales with ATK.
abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Earth.

abilities.name: Whirlwind Strike
abilities.description: Kazeto spins her mace in a wide circle, dealing X physical damage to all enemies within a 300-unit radius. Each enemy hit grants Kazeto 1 stack of Gale Force. If Kazeto has 5 or more Gale Force stacks, this ability's radius is increased by 50 units, and enemies hit are slowed by 30% for 2 seconds. This ability has a cooldown of 8 seconds and costs 60 mana. Gale Force stacks last for 8 seconds before decaying one by one.
abilities.flavorQuote: Let's see how you handle a little spin!

abilities.name: Gust Dash
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~6% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Kazeto dashes forward a short distance (400 units), dealing X physical damage to the first enemy she passes through. If Kazeto has less than 5 stacks of Gale Force, this dash grants her 2 stacks. If Kazeto has 5 or more stacks, she consumes 3 stacks to extend the dash distance to 600 units and knock the enemy back 200 units. This ability has a cooldown of 10 seconds and costs 40 mana.
abilities.flavorQuote: Catch me if you can! Nya!

abilities.name: Neko Reflexes
upgrades: (Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~22%).
abilities.description: Kazeto passively gains 5% increased movement speed and 3% increased attack damage. Additionally, for every stack of Gale Force she has, her attack speed is increased by 2%. When Kazeto reaches 10 stacks of Gale Force, her next basic attack within 5 seconds critically strikes for 150% damage and consumes all stacks. Gale Force stacks decay one at a time after 8 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: I'm way faster than you think!

abilities.name: Mountain's Fury
abilities.description: Kazeto slams her mace into the ground, creating a localized earthquake. Enemies within a 250-unit radius are stunned for 1 second and take X physical damage. If Kazeto has any stacks of Gale Force, she consumes them to empower the ability. For each stack consumed, the stun duration is increased by 0.1 seconds and the damage is increased by 5%. This ability has a cooldown of 14 seconds and costs 80 mana.
abilities.flavorQuote: Feel the wrath of the mountain!

abilities.name: Tempestuous Onslaught
abilities.description: Kazeto unleashes a furious barrage of attacks, becoming untargetable for 3 seconds. During this time, she rapidly strikes all enemies within a 400-unit radius, dealing a total of X physical damage divided evenly among them. If Kazeto has any stacks of Gale Force, she consumes them to enhance the ultimate. For each stack consumed, the total damage is increased by 8% and the radius is increased by 10 units. After the barrage, Kazeto lands, gaining a shield equal to 10% of the total damage dealt during the ultimate, lasting for 5 seconds. This ability has a cooldown of 90 seconds and costs 120 mana.
abilities.flavorQuote: Prepare for the storm!

character_v1.playstyle: Mobile, burst damage, area control
character_v1.teamSynergy: Kazeto benefits from allies who can provide crowd control or mobility buffs, allowing her to more easily build and maintain Gale Force stacks. She can also act as an initiator with her Gust Dash or Mountain's Fury, setting up opportunities for her team to follow up with damage.
character_v1.tierSummary: Kazeto's SS tier placement is suspect given roster saturation; while *Tempestuous Onslaught* offers strong untargetability and *Neko Reflexes* scales favorably, her dependence on short-range AoE damage in *Whirlwind Strike* and *Mountain's Fury* clashes with her bruiser role. Her kit lacks the true sustain or disruptive control tools expected of top-tier brawlers, with *Gust Dash* functioning primarily as a repositioning tool rather than a gap closer; ultimately, she offers a mixed bag of gale force damage, which is likely inflated due to ease of implementation of the mechanic and favorable damage numbers. Considering the existence of similar peers like Tao who execute the hybrid damage/assassin role more effectively, Kazeto's inflated winrate relative to true agency-driving abilities is unsubstantiated, warranting a second look and potential reassessment downwards.
appearanceTags: Green-haired neko girl with cat ears and tail
Wields a spiked mace on a chain
Wears a black and green gothic lolita-inspired outfit
character_v1.internalSynergy: Kazeto's kit is designed around building and expending Gale Force stacks. Whirlwind Strike and Gust Dash provide initial stacks, while Neko Reflexes rewards maintaining high stacks. Mountain's Fury and Tempestuous Onslaught offer powerful options for consuming those stacks, either for targeted control or widespread damage.

character_v1.name: Valentino

abilities.name: Basic Attack
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling
Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction
mechanics: Ranged single strike.
Scales with ATK.
abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Wind.

abilities.name: Sweet Talk
abilities.description: Valentino unleashes a wave of charm in a cone-shaped area in front of him, dealing X magic damage and inflicting 'Infatuation' on enemies hit for 3 seconds. Infatuated enemies are drawn towards Valentino and have their attack damage reduced by 20%. If the target already has stacks of 'Contractual Obligation', the duration of Infatuation is increased by 1 second per stack, up to a maximum of 6 seconds. This ability has a cooldown of 8 seconds and consumes 50 mana. Valentino’s silver tongue can sway even the most stalwart of foes, bending them to his will with honeyed words and false promises. Range: 500 units.
abilities.flavorQuote: Come closer, darling. Let's make a deal.

abilities.name: Red Light District
abilities.description: Valentino creates a zone of 'Red Light' at a target location that lasts for 5 seconds. Enemies within the zone are slowed by 30% and take X magic damage per second. Additionally, enemies entering the zone gain 1 stack of 'Contractual Obligation' every second, up to a maximum of 3 stacks while inside. This ability has a cooldown of 12 seconds and consumes 75 mana. The air shimmers with lust and desperation, a playground where Valentino holds all the cards, and pleasure comes at a steep price. Zone Radius: 300 units, Cast Range: 700 units.
abilities.flavorQuote: Welcome to my domain. You can check out any time you like, but you can never leave.

abilities.name: Soul Contract
abilities.description: Valentino marks a target enemy with a 'Soul Contract' for 8 seconds. While under the effect of 'Soul Contract', the target takes 15% increased damage from all sources. If the target has 3 or more stacks of 'Contractual Obligation', this ability also charms the target, forcing them to attack their nearest ally for 2 seconds. This ability has a cooldown of 15 seconds and consumes 100 mana. The contract is signed in blood and sealed with a kiss, a twisted agreement where the only winner is Valentino. Range: 600 units.
abilities.flavorQuote: Sign here, darling. It's just a formality… mostly.

abilities.name: Overlord's Aura
abilities.description: Valentino passively exudes an aura of dominance. Allies within 400 units gain 10% increased attack damage and 10 tenacity. Enemies within the same radius have their healing received reduced by 15%. In addition, whenever an enemy gains a stack of 'Contractual Obligation', Valentino gains a shield equal to 3% of his maximum health, stacking up to a maximum of 15% of his max HP as a shield. This shield lasts for 5 seconds. The air crackles with power, a testament to Valentino's influence and a constant reminder of his control.
abilities.flavorQuote: Remember who you're working for.

abilities.name: Curtain Call
abilities.description: Valentino unleashes his full Overlord power, creating a massive wave of seductive energy in a large area around him. All enemies within 600 units are dealt X magic damage and gain 3 stacks of 'Contractual Obligation'. For the next 6 seconds, enemies with 5 or more stacks of 'Contractual Obligation' are 'Enslaved', forcing them to fight for Valentino, attacking only enemy units. At the end of the enslavement, those affected are stunned for 1.5 seconds as the effect wears off. This ability has a cooldown of 120 seconds and consumes 200 mana. The stage is set, the lights are dimmed, and the audience is captivated. It's showtime, and Valentino is calling the shots. The greatest trick the devil ever pulled was convincing the world he didn't exist, but Valentino ensures they remember his name.
abilities.flavorQuote: Let's give them a show they'll never forget!

character_v1.playstyle: Valentino excels at manipulating enemies, forcing them to turn on each other, and controlling the battlefield with debuffs and area denial. He thrives in prolonged engagements where he can stack 'Contractual Obligation' and turn the tide of battle through strategic target prioritization.
character_v1.teamSynergy: Valentino synergizes well with damage dealers who can capitalize on the increased damage from 'Soul Contract' and crowd control supports who can help him keep enemies within 'Red Light District'. He also benefits from tanks who can peel for him while he stacks 'Contractual Obligation'.
character_v1.tierSummary: Valentino's S-tier status hinges on a potent control mage kit defined by `Sweet Talk` and `Red Light District` for consistent zoning and crowd control, exacerbated by `Soul Contract`'s damage amplification. He carves a niche amongst Controllers by layering multiple overlapping status effects. However, his reliance on combo execution for optimal output leaves him vulnerable compared to raw damage dealers and more resilient tanks, demanding precise play for viability in the crowded Controller meta. The absence of immediate burst damage and reliance on sustained engagements limit his appeal relative to burst-heavy peers like Tao, positioning him as a tactical pick rather than a universal powerhouse.
appearanceTags: Tall moth demon with pink skin
Signature red coat formed from wings
character_v1.internalSynergy: Valentino's kit revolves around building 'Contractual Obligation' stacks. 'Red Light District' is the primary stacking tool, while 'Soul Contract' and 'Curtain Call' capitalize on high stacks to charm or enslave enemies. 'Sweet Talk' provides initial control and synergizes with Contractual Obligation for longer durations. The Overlord's Aura adds sustain and team utility.

character_v1.name: Honey the Cat

abilities.name: Basic Attack
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling
Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction
mechanics: Ranged single strike.
Scales with ATK.
abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Dark.

abilities.name: Shadow Sneak
abilities.description: Honey dashes a short distance, becoming briefly invulnerable during the dash. Upon reaching the destination, she leaves behind a 'Fashion Illusion' at her starting point that lasts for 3 seconds. Enemies that touch the Fashion Illusion are slowed by 30% for 2 seconds. If Honey has at least one active 'Pop-Up Shop', the slow duration is increased to 4 seconds. Multiple uses within 5 seconds reduce the dash distance by 25% per stack, resetting after the cooldown. This ability allows Honey to quickly reposition and create strategic chokepoints.
abilities.flavorQuote: Did you see me move? Neither did they!

abilities.name: Pop-Up Shop
abilities.description: Honey deploys a temporary 'Pop-Up Shop' at the target location. The shop lasts for 15 seconds and grants vision in a small radius. Enemies within the radius take 10 true damage per second. The maximum number of active Pop-Up Shops is 3. Each active Pop-Up Shop grants Honey 'Brand Awareness', increasing the effectiveness of her other abilities. Deploying a new shop while at the maximum number despawns the oldest shop. Enemies destroying a Pop-Up Shop refund 25% of the cooldown. This ability is core to Honey's zone control, creating areas of denial and empowering her kit.
abilities.flavorQuote: Now open! Limited time only!

abilities.name: Flashbulb Frenzy
abilities.description: Honey deploys a high-tech, autonomously functioning photography drone to the target location, armed with a powerful strobe emitter. Upon reaching its destination, the drone unleashes a blinding series of rapid-fire flashes, creating a zone of disorienting light. Enemies caught within the area of effect are afflicted with the 'Blinded' status, significantly reducing their accuracy by 50% and their movement speed by 25% for a duration of 4 seconds, making them easy targets for your allies. Moreover, the sheer intensity of the strobe lights momentarily overloads enemy sensory systems. If Honey has at least two active 'Pop-Up Shops' on the field, the flashbulb frenzy also inflicts 'Stunned' for 0.75 seconds, temporarily incapacitating the affected enemies, further enhancing the crowd control capabilities of this dazzling display. The drone has limited battery life and will automatically deactivate after 6 seconds, so be sure to time your deployment carefully to maximize its disruptive potential. This ability is invaluable for disrupting enemy formations, hindering their offensive capabilities, and providing crucial windows of opportunity for your team to capitalize on their disoriented state.
abilities.flavorQuote: Say cheese! ...And then try aiming properly!

abilities.name: Signature Style
abilities.description: Honey's basic attacks and abilities apply a stack of 'Style Points' to enemies hit, up to a maximum of 5 stacks. Each stack of Style Points reduces the target's magic defense by 3%. When a target reaches 5 stacks, Honey gains a burst of speed, increasing her movement speed by 20% for 3 seconds. The speed boost is doubled if Honey has 3 'Pop-Up Shops' active. The stacks decay one at a time, every 2 seconds. This passive encourages aggressive play and rewards Honey for maintaining pressure on her opponents.
abilities.flavorQuote: Everyone wants a piece of my style!

abilities.name: Haute Couture Catwalk
abilities.description: Honey creates a dazzling 'Catwalk' in a line in front of her. The Catwalk lasts for 8 seconds. Allies moving along the Catwalk gain 30% increased movement speed and are healed for 3% of their max HP per second. Enemies moving along the Catwalk are slowed by 40% and take 50 magic damage per second. The Catwalk's speed and healing effects are increased by 20% for each active 'Pop-Up Shop', up to a maximum of 60%. This ultimate provides significant utility for both offense and defense, allowing Honey to control the flow of battle and support her team.
abilities.flavorQuote: Strut your stuff on my runway!

character_v1.playstyle: Honey excels at controlling areas with her 'Pop-Up Shops' and disrupting enemy formations with agile movements and fashion-themed debuffs. She focuses on strategic positioning and empowering her abilities through Brand Awareness.
character_v1.teamSynergy: Honey excels on teams that can capitalize on her zone control and debuffs. She pairs well with high-damage characters who can quickly eliminate weakened enemies. Her Haute Couture Catwalk provides valuable support for mobile teams or those needing sustain in prolonged fights. Characters that can further enhance her area denial, such as those with traps or summons, also synergize well with Honey.
character_v1.tierSummary: Honey's S-Tier viability stems from the oppressive zone control granted by 'Pop-Up Shop' combined with 'Fashion Forward' for burst silencing, creating no-go zones. 'Shadow Sneak' provides crucial repositioning and brief invulnerability, compensating for her inherent fragility against true assassins. 'Signature Style' passive scaling synergizes effectively with extended skirmishes, augmenting her damage output. Compared to peers like Mother Brain and Vicious, Honey sacrifices raw damage for superior mobility and tactical denial. Her reliance on stacking debuffs and strategic shop placement, however, leaves her vulnerable to burst compositions and strong dispel options, demanding precise execution to maintain dominance.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Honey's abilities synergize around her 'Pop-Up Shops'. She uses these shops to control zones, gain Brand Awareness, and empower her other abilities. Shadow Sneak allows for quick repositioning, while Fashion Forward and Signature Style provide debuffs that weaken enemies within her controlled areas. Haute Couture Catwalk is a powerful ultimate that can turn the tide of battle, especially when amplified by multiple active shops.

character_v1.name: Iron Man

abilities.name: Basic Attack
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling
Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction
mechanics: Ranged single strike.
Scales with ATK.
abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Physical.

abilities.name: Repulsor Blast
abilities.description: Iron Man unleashes a focused beam of energy from his gauntlets, dealing 90 (+60% magic atk) magic damage to the first enemy hit. This ability generates 10 Repulsor Charge. If Iron Man has at least 30 Repulsor Charge, he can consume it to empower the blast, causing it to pierce through the first enemy and deal 50% damage to enemies behind the initial target. The empowered blast also applies a stacking debuff, reducing the target's magic defense by 5% for 5 seconds, stacking up to 3 times, amplifying subsequent damage. This ability has a 6-second cooldown, allowing for frequent use and strategic resource management.
abilities.flavorQuote: Time to even the odds.

abilities.name: Arc Overload
abilities.description: Iron Man channels the Arc Reactor's energy, creating a surge around him that lasts for 4 seconds. During Arc Overload, his basic attacks gain 40% lifesteal and inflict an additional 30 (+20% magic atk) magic damage on hit. Activating Arc Overload consumes 20 Repulsor Charge. If Iron Man has less than 20 Repulsor Charge, the lifesteal is reduced to 20%. This ability has a 12-second cooldown. The synergy between lifesteal and bonus damage makes it a potent tool for sustaining Iron Man in prolonged engagements, encouraging players to balance resource expenditure with strategic timing. The ability benefits from a high magic attack stat.
abilities.flavorQuote: Let's crank up the juice!

abilities.name: Jet Propulsion
abilities.description: Iron Man engages his suit's thrusters, dashing a short distance in a target direction. This ability grants him a brief shield, absorbing up to 150 (+30% magic def) damage for 2 seconds. Jet Propulsion generates 15 Repulsor Charge upon use. If Iron Man has at least 40 Repulsor Charge, he can consume it to extend the dash distance by 50% and increase the shield value by 75 (+15% magic def). This ability has a 10-second cooldown. Jet Propulsion offers both offensive and defensive capabilities, allowing Iron Man to reposition, engage, or escape from danger effectively. It also promotes strategic use of Repulsor Charge for enhanced mobility and survivability.
abilities.flavorQuote: Gotta go fast!

abilities.name: Adaptive Armor (Passive)
abilities.description: Iron Man's armor passively adapts to incoming threats. Every 5 seconds, he gains a buff based on the type of damage he has received most recently. If the last damage received was physical, he gains 15 armor. If the last damage received was magical, he gains 15 magic resistance. These bonuses last for 5 seconds. Additionally, Iron Man's maximum Repulsor Charge is increased by 25. This passive encourages players to be aware of the damage types they are facing and to adjust their playstyle accordingly, adding a layer of strategic depth to Iron Man's kit.
abilities.flavorQuote: My systems are always learning.

abilities.name: Hulkbuster Protocol (Ultimate)
abilities.description: Iron Man deploys the Hulkbuster armor, transforming for 12 seconds. While in Hulkbuster mode, his HP is increased by 500, his attack damage is increased by 60, and he gains the Unstoppable status, rendering him immune to crowd control effects. Each basic attack during this time consumes 5 Repulsor Charge and deals area damage in a small cone in front of him, dealing 50 (+30% atk) physical damage to all enemies hit. After the duration ends, Iron Man reverts to his normal form. This ability has a long 60-second cooldown. The Hulkbuster Protocol serves as Iron Man's ultimate trump card, allowing him to temporarily become a formidable melee threat and turn the tide of battle.
abilities.flavorQuote: Time to bring out the big guns!

character_v1.playstyle: Resource Management, Sustained Damage, High Mobility
character_v1.teamSynergy: Iron Man pairs well with characters who can provide crowd control or healing. Crowd control allows him to land his 'Repulsor Blast' and 'Hulkbuster Protocol' area attacks more easily, while healing helps him sustain through damage and maximize the benefits of 'Arc Overload'.
character_v1.tierSummary: Iron Man's S-tier placement is aggressively optimistic; while Repulsor Blast offers decent scaling and the Hulkbuster Protocol provides brief immunity and AoE, his reliance on 'Repulsor Charge' for ability synergy feels clunky. Compared to peers like Tao and Aang who offer immediate impact, Iron Man's damage output is noticeably delayed and conditional. Adaptive Armor is a band-aid on inherent squishiness, not true tank synergy. His viability hinges entirely on exploiting Arc Overload's lifesteal during Hulkbuster, a predictable and easily countered strategy, rendering him a situational pick, not a consistent S-tier threat; consider him S- only.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Iron Man's kit revolves around managing Repulsor Charge. 'Repulsor Blast' and 'Jet Propulsion' generate Charge, while 'Arc Overload' and 'Hulkbuster Protocol' consume it for enhanced effects. Adaptive Armor provides passive defensive buffs, allowing him to withstand various damage types.

character_v1.name: Captain America

abilities.name: Basic Attack
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling
Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction
mechanics: Ranged single strike.
Scales with ATK.
abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Electric.

abilities.name: Shield Block
abilities.description: Captain America automatically blocks the next incoming basic attack every 8 seconds, reducing the damage taken by 75% and generating 1 stack of Vibranium Resonance. Additionally, each time Captain America is struck by an AOE attack he gains 1 stack of Vibranium Resonance. This ability has a cooldown of 2 seconds for AOE attacks. Vibranium Resonance stacks up to a maximum of 5. When Captain America reaches 5 stacks, he consumes all stacks to enter 'Rallying Cry' state for 5 seconds, granting himself and all allies within a moderate radius 15% increased attack speed and 10% damage reduction. Damage Reduction will not stack.
abilities.flavorQuote: I can do this all day.

abilities.name: Vibranium Throw
abilities.description: Captain America throws his shield at the targeted enemy, dealing 120% ATK as physical damage. If Captain America has any stacks of Vibranium Resonance, this ability consumes one stack to cause the shield to ricochet to one additional nearby enemy, dealing 80% ATK as physical damage. If the ricocheted target is affected by a debuff (stun, slow, etc) the primary target also gains the same debuff with a 50% effectiveness and duration of 1 second. Captain America regains his shield automatically after 3 seconds or immediately if he uses another ability.
abilities.flavorQuote: He's all over the place!

abilities.name: Strategic Advance
abilities.description: Captain America dashes towards the targeted ally, granting them a shield equal to 10% of his max HP for 4 seconds. While the shield is active, all damage the shielded ally takes is redirected to Captain America. Consumes 1 stack of Vibranium Resonance to cleanse one debuff from the ally before applying the shield. This ability has a range slightly larger than average. This ability can be used on himself. If no ally is targeted, Captain America simply dashes a short distance.
abilities.flavorQuote: Avengers, move out!

abilities.name: Mjolnir's Call
abilities.description: Captain America calls upon Mjolnir, imbuing his shield with its power for 8 seconds. While active, basic attacks deal additional 50% magic attack as electric damage, and the 'Vibranium Throw' ability now calls lightning at the target area dealing 100% magic attack as electric damage to enemies within a small area of effect. This ability has a cooldown of 15 seconds. Consumes 2 stacks of Vibranium Resonance to also grant himself 30% increased magic defense for the duration. This ability can only be used if Captain America has at least 2 stacks of Vibranium Resonance.
abilities.flavorQuote: I can do this all day... and summon lightning!

abilities.name: Final Stand
abilities.description: Captain America inspires his team, greatly boosting their effectiveness for 10 seconds. For the duration, all allies have 25% increased atk, def, magic atk, and magic def. In addition, Captain America becomes immune to all crowd control effects and gains 50% damage reduction. After the duration ends, Captain America consumes all stacks of Vibranium Resonance, healing all allies within a large radius for X HP per stack consumed. This heal scales with 50% of Captain America's defense and 50% of his magic defense.
abilities.flavorQuote: Avengers, assemble!

character_v1.playstyle: Durable Frontline Defender and Team Buffer
character_v1.teamSynergy: Provides excellent team-wide buffs and consistent mitigation, enabling aggressive compositions and providing protection to backline allies.
character_v1.tierSummary: Captain America's 'S' tier placement is questionable given the current meta; while his Vibranium Resonance abilities provide decent utility, they fail to synergize into a cohesive, impactful tanking strategy compared to peers like Tao and Aang. Strategic Advance offers limited shield value, and Mjolnir's Call has a cooldown that is long; these abilities offer some support, but his ultimate, Final Stand, is a generic stat boost lacking the disruption or hard CC necessary for decisive team fights. He's outclassed in direct tanking, lacks the burst to secure kills, and his utility is too conditional and underpowered to justify his high tier, making him a mediocre pick overall; he is a shield bot support at best.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Vibranium Resonance stacks enhance both offensive and defensive capabilities, with many abilities interacting with the passive to provide additional effects.

character_v1.name: Black Panther

abilities.name: Basic Attack
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling
Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction
mechanics: Ranged single strike.
Scales with ATK.
abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Dark.

abilities.name: Panther's Grace
upgrades: (Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~16%).
abilities.description: Black Panther is perpetually enveloped by Wakandan nanites, granting him unparalleled agility. He gains a 15% increase in movement speed and a 10% bonus to evasion. Furthermore, Black Panther's unique Vibranium suit absorbs incoming damage, converting 30% of all damage taken into Kinetic Energy. This energy can be unleashed through his other abilities. The maximum Kinetic Energy Black Panther can store is equal to 200% of his maximum health. Managing Kinetic Energy is crucial to maximizing Black Panther's effectiveness in battle, allowing for powerful bursts of damage or tactical maneuvers.
abilities.flavorQuote: Agility and resilience, the hallmarks of the Panther.

abilities.name: Vibranium Strike
abilities.description: Black Panther unleashes a swift, precisely aimed strike with his Vibranium claws. Deals 100% of attack damage as physical damage to the target. If Black Panther has at least 25% Kinetic Energy stored, he can expend it to empower the strike, increasing the damage to 150% and applying a stacking bleed effect, dealing 10% of attack damage as true damage over 3 seconds, stacking up to 3 times. This ability has a cooldown of 5 seconds. Strategic use of Kinetic Energy allows Black Panther to control the flow of battle, applying pressure with sustained damage or conserving energy for more strategic plays.
abilities.flavorQuote: A single strike, perfectly executed.

abilities.name: Shadow Pounce
abilities.description: Black Panther utilizes his advanced suit technology to briefly become nearly invisible, dashing a short distance to a target location. If Black Panther has at least 50% Kinetic Energy stored, expending it during the dash grants him true invisibility for 1.5 seconds upon arrival. The dash has a range of 8 units and a cooldown of 10 seconds. The true invisibility effect breaks upon attacking or using another ability. This ability enables Black Panther to swiftly reposition, initiate ambushes, or evade danger, making him a difficult target to pin down.
abilities.flavorQuote: They cannot see me, but they will feel me.

abilities.name: Kinetic Burst
abilities.description: Black Panther expends all stored Kinetic Energy to unleash a powerful burst of energy, dealing damage to all enemies within a 5-unit radius. The damage dealt is equal to 50% of the expended Kinetic Energy as magic damage. Additionally, enemies hit by the burst are slowed by 30% for 2 seconds. This ability has a cooldown of 15 seconds. Careful management of Kinetic Energy is essential to maximizing the impact of this ability, allowing Black Panther to deliver devastating area-of-effect damage and control the battlefield.
abilities.flavorQuote: The power I absorb, I unleash!

abilities.name: Wakandan Tech Adaptation
abilities.description: Black Panther analyzes the battlefield and instantaneously adapts his suit to exploit enemy weaknesses. For 10 seconds, Black Panther gains a stacking buff based on damage received. For every instance of physical damage received, his attack damage increases by 5%, stacking up to 5 times. For every instance of magic damage received, his magic attack damage increases by 5%, stacking up to 5 times. This effect lasts for 8 seconds after activation. This ability has a cooldown of 60 seconds. This adaptation showcases Black Panther's tactical brilliance and access to advanced Wakandan technology, allowing him to turn enemy attacks into opportunities for increased damage output.
abilities.flavorQuote: Wakanda's technology, always evolving.

character_v1.playstyle: Reactive, burst-damage, mobile
character_v1.teamSynergy: Black Panther synergizes well with tanks who can draw enemy fire, maximizing his Kinetic Energy generation. He also benefits from allies who can provide crowd control, allowing him to safely unleash Kinetic Burst or reposition with Shadow Pounce. Damage amplifiers can further enhance his burst damage potential.
character_v1.tierSummary: Black Panther's S-tier placement hinges on 'Panther's Grace' for sustain and speed, synergizing with 'Shadow Pounce' for deceptive engagement and amplified 'Vibranium Strike' follow-ups. 'Kinetic Burst' provides crucial AoE control, scaling with 'Panther's Grace' uptime, although its reliance on stored energy can lead to vulnerability. He competes directly with Tao and Aang for dominance, requiring precise execution to outmaneuver their raw power, but offers more consistent utility than most S-tiers like Cloud. His ultimate, 'Wakandan Tech Adaptation', provides adaptive scaling that keeps him relevant across diverse matchups, a key differentiator in the current meta.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Black Panther's kit revolves around absorbing damage to fuel his abilities, creating a reactive playstyle. Kinetic Burst benefits from sustained damage intake, while Vibranium Strike and Shadow Pounce offer strategic options for burst damage or repositioning based on available Kinetic Energy. Wakandan Tech Adaptation enhances his damage output based on the types of damage he receives, rewarding adaptability.

character_v1.name: Squirrel Girl

This ability is best used to disrupt enemy movement and set up opportunities for your team to engage. The squirrels are surprisingly coordinated, and know precisely where to nip to cause maximum inconvenience.
abilities.flavorQuote: Time for a nutty surprise!

abilities.name: Nutty Command
abilities.description: Squirrel Girl generates 5 Acorns every 2 seconds. The maximum number of Acorns she can hold is 100. Additionally, allies near Squirrel Girl gain 5% increased movement speed. This passive allows Squirrel Girl to maintain a steady flow of resources, enabling consistent use of her active abilities. Positioning near allies is crucial to maximize the utility of the movement speed bonus, enhancing their mobility in skirmishes and rotations. Proper acorn management is key to playing Squirrel Girl effectively, balancing spending for immediate impact versus saving for larger, more impactful abilities.
abilities.flavorQuote: Gather 'round, it's time to strategize!

abilities.description: Squirrel Girl spends 30 Acorns to grant an ally a shield that absorbs X damage for 4 seconds. If the shield is not broken before it expires, the ally gains 10% increased attack damage for 6 seconds. This ability offers both immediate protection and a delayed offensive buff, rewarding skillful timing and target selection. Prioritize shielding allies who are likely to take significant damage or those who can best capitalize on the subsequent damage boost. The visual effect is quite charming - your ally becomes briefly covered in adorable acorn-shaped protective charms.
abilities.flavorQuote: A little protection goes a long way!

abilities.name: Tippy-Toe's Gambit
abilities.description: Squirrel Girl commands Tippy-Toe to target an enemy, taunting them for 1.5 seconds. During this time, the enemy's damage is reduced by 15%. If the target attacks Tippy-Toe during this period, Tippy-Toe evades the attack and the enemy is rooted for 0.75 seconds, consuming Tippy-Toe. (Tippy-Toe respawns after 10 seconds). This ability offers a strong interrupt and damage mitigation tool, particularly effective against high-damage burst champions. Sacrifice Tippy-Toe strategically to control enemy aggression and create openings for your team. It is important to note that because Tippy-Toe is so small, most enemies don't realize they've even been taunted, leading to hilarious and effective results.
abilities.flavorQuote: Alright, Tippy-Toe, you're up!

abilities.name: Squirrel Stampede
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~12% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Squirrel Girl unleashes a massive stampede of squirrels, spending all remaining Acorns. The squirrels charge forward in a wide line, dealing X magic damage to all enemies they pass through and knocking them up for 1 second. For every 10 Acorns spent, the damage increases by 5% and the knock-up duration increases by 0.1 seconds. (Max 2 seconds total). This ultimate provides a devastating area-of-effect crowd control option, capable of turning the tide of team fights. Maximize its effectiveness by positioning yourself to hit multiple enemies simultaneously, and ensure you have a substantial amount of Acorns stocked up to maximize the impact of the stampede. Squirrels pour out of her pockets, from behind trees - it's truly a sight to behold.
abilities.flavorQuote: Release the swarm!

character_v1.playstyle: Area Control, Buffing, Debuffing
character_v1.teamSynergy: Squirrel Girl excels in teams that benefit from area control and damage amplification. Her crowd control abilities can create opportunities for burst damage dealers, while her shields and damage buffs enhance the survivability and damage output of sustained damage champions.
character_v1.tierSummary: Squirrel Girl's acorn-based economy is slow and easily disrupted, diminishing her support capabilities compared to higher-tier supports; while Acorn Armor offers decent shielding, its cost inhibits consistent application. Her reliance on Acorns for both defense and offense creates a resource conflict, hindering her effectiveness in extended engagements, especially against resource-draining compositions. Tippy-Toe's Gambit offers brief taunt utility, but its short duration fails to compensate for a lack of sustained CC or impactful debuffs present in more effective controllers. Squirrel Stampede's scaling damage relies heavily on accumulated Acorns, making it predictable and easily countered, limiting its viability as a decisive ultimate relative to other A-tier area of effect characters.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Squirrel Girl's kit revolves around generating and spending Acorns to empower her abilities and control the battlefield. The passive Acorn generation fuels the active abilities, creating a gameplay loop of resource management and tactical execution. Tippy-Toe's Gambit allows for disruption, creating set ups for the Squirrel Barrage and Squirrel Stampede.

abilities.description: Panda embodies the might of three distinct Cursed Corpse forms dwelling within him: Panda, Gorilla, and Rhino, each a repository of specialized combat prowess and vulnerabilities. Panda begins each battle in his balanced Panda form, a versatile state of equilibrium. Upon activating most of his other abilities, Panda briefly channels the essence of the corresponding form, unleashing its unique advantages for 4 seconds. The Normal Panda form provides a consistent boon, increasing Tenacity by 12%, bolstering Panda's resistance to crowd control effects. The Gorilla form surges with raw aggression, granting a 24% increase to Attack, but reducing Defense by 12%. Conversely, the Rhino form fortifies Panda's defenses, increasing Defense by 24% while reducing Attack by 12%. However, over-reliance on a single form strains its internal integrity. Each form possesses a Core Integrity score, starting at 100. Each time Panda shifts to a specific form, its corresponding Core Integrity is reduced by 33. Once a Core's Integrity reaches 0, Panda cannot access that form until it regenerates to full Integrity. This regeneration process takes a fixed 5 seconds for each form, encouraging tactical decisions on when and which form to adopt. This constant interplay between forms and integrity management turns Panda into a strategic battlefield manipulator, demanding careful planning and predictive awareness. The careful management of Core Integrity is paramount to unleashing Panda's full potential, requiring him to alternate forms effectively to avoid locking himself out of crucial buffs or damage mitigation at critical moments.

abilities.description: Panda, true to his nature, expresses himself through a flurry of precise, yet powerful, strikes. Over the course of 2 seconds, he unleashes a series of jabs, each strike dealing a calculated 60 plus 60% of Panda's Attack stat as physical damage to his chosen target. Panda's stance dictates the additional effects accompanying this flurry. When in his default, composed state, each application of 'Expressive Beatdown' leaves the target with a stack of 'Perplexed'. 'Perplexed' reduces the target's Defense by 5% per stack, with a maximum of 3 stacks, representing their bewilderment at Panda's fighting style. When Panda shifts into his volatile Gorilla Mode, the 'Expressive Beatdown' becomes even more potent, now dealing 90 plus 90% of Panda's Attack damage and grants Panda 10% Lifesteal for the duration of the strikes. Shifting into his sturdy Triceratops stance grants Panda a shield for 3 seconds, absorbing 80 damage, plus 80% of his Defense stat, and if that shield is broken, it will apply the 'Taunt' status effect for one second to the target, compelling them to focus their attention on the undeniably charming Panda.

abilities.description: Panda delves deep within his complex Cursed Corpse constitution, unleashing a rapid-fire, six-second metamorphosis through his three distinct cores. With each transformation, Panda gains access to the unique active ability tied to that specific form, dramatically enhancing both his offensive and defensive capabilities in a whirlwind of controlled chaos. The transformation sequence adheres to a strict, unyielding order: Normal Core, then Gorilla Core, finally Triceratops Core, with each form dominating Panda's physical and energetic presence for exactly 2 seconds, demanding unwavering focus and precise control. As each core is activated, the strain is palpable, immediately draining 15 Core Integrity from the corresponding source, forcing Panda to carefully manage his inner reserves. As the final form's influence wanes, the accumulated stress takes its toll, abruptly draining an additional 20 Core Integrity from his remaining reserves. This adaptive onslaught unleashes a total of 450 + (4.5 * Atk) physical damage to all enemies within a generous radius, pulverizing their defenses with each successive shift, while simultaneously manifesting a protective shield around Panda, absorbing 100 + (1.0 * Def) damage from incoming attacks. The sheer force of these consecutive forms threatens to overwhelm any foe that dares to challenge Panda's metamorphic might.

character_v1.playstyle: Stance-Switching Brawler
character_v1.teamSynergy: Panda excels as a frontline bruiser who can adapt to different combat scenarios. His ability to Taunt and provide shields makes him a valuable asset for protecting squishier teammates, while his Gorilla form allows him to deal significant damage. He synergizes well with teams that can capitalize on his defensive buffs or provide additional crowd control.
character_v1.tierSummary: Panda's kit struggles to define a clear bruiser identity; while Cursed Core Resonance offers versatility, the stance-dancing gameplay lacks the immediate impact required in a saturated A-tier. Normal Pummel's utility is overshadowed by superior tank-synergy options, and Gorilla Beatdown's single-target burst is insufficient compared to dedicated damage dealers. Tricera-Defense offers sustain, but the conditional shield and heal are unreliable. Multi-Core Symphony's protracted duration and reliance on survivability leave Panda vulnerable to burst and disruption, placing him below the top-performing bruisers who offer more consistent damage or control.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Panda's kit revolves around managing his Core Integrity to maximize the effectiveness of his stances. Balancing offensive and defensive forms, while avoiding overusing any single core, is crucial for sustained damage output and survivability.

Cream radiates a passive aura that, at its base level, grants nearby allies (within 500 units) a 3% increase to their movement speed; this subtle boost represents the gentle encouragement emanating from the Chao's playful spirits. As Cream assists her teammates (by successfully landing a healing ability, applying a beneficial buff, or dispelling a negative effect), the Chao Garden's influence expands. Each successful assist grants Cream a stack of "Bloom", up to a maximum of 5 stacks. Each stack of Bloom increases the radius of the aura by 50 units, its movement speed bonus by 1% and grants allies a small, but perceptible, 1% increase to their HP regeneration rate; these accumulated benefits symbolize the blossoming vibrancy of the Chao Garden. Furthermore, upon reaching maximum Bloom stacks, Cream's next healing ability will also grant the targeted ally a temporary shield equal to 10% of their maximum health, protecting them with a wave of pure, innocent Chao energy. This shield will degrade over 3 seconds, rewarding proactive support play and further emphasizing her role as a nurturing cornerstone for her team. The Bloom stacks will reset when Cream is downed.
abilities.flavorQuote: "Let's make everyone feel safe and happy! Like in a Chao Garden!"

abilities.name: Cream's Chao Garden
