abilities.description: Don-chan channels pure musical energy, unleashing a rapid-fire drumbeat barrage in a target area, disrupting foes with rhythmic chaos. Upon activation, Don-chan must successfully perform a sequence of six 'Don' or 'Ka' inputs within a tight 3-second window. Each successful input resonates outwards, weakening the resolve of enemies caught in the barrage's wake. Each successful input reduces the attack speed and movement speed of enemies within the affected area by a palpable 8% for a duration of 4 seconds; these effects stack additively, intensifying the rhythmic oppression with each perfectly timed strike. However, any incorrect input shatters the rhythmic flow, instantly resetting the debuff duration and demanding unwavering precision to maintain the cacophony of disruption. Should Don-chan flawlessly execute all six inputs, enemies are not only slowed but also afflicted with 'Rhythm Break,' a profound disruption that reduces their tenacity by a substantial 20% for the full duration of the barrage. Drumbeat Barrage has a 12-second cooldown, requiring strategic timing to effectively cripple enemy formations and exploit vulnerabilities exposed by rhythmic discord.

This passive encourages skillful play and rewards precise execution, while punishing mistakes. abilities.description: Don-chan channels the ultimate rhythmic power, unleashing a symphony of sound that both empowers allies and damages enemies. Upon activation, a complex sequence of 8 'Don' and 'Ka' inputs appears, each with a shorter timing window than previous abilities. Successfully completing the sequence grants all allies 'Sonic Harmony' for 7 seconds, increasing their speed by 15% and granting them 10% lifesteal. Simultaneously, enemies within a large radius take magic damage equal to 15% of Don-chan's magic attack. If the sequence fails, allies only gain 7.5% speed and 5% lifesteal for 3 seconds, and enemies take only 7.5% of Don-chan's magic attack as damage. Sonic Symphony has a long cooldown of 25 seconds, making it a high-risk, high-reward ultimate ability.
abilities.flavorQuote: Hear the music, feel the might!

abilities.name: Precision Performance
abilities.description: Don-chan's innate sense of rhythm allows for enhanced precision. The timing window for 'Don' and 'Ka' inputs is increased by 10%. Additionally, for every three successful 'Rhythm Resonance' sequences completed without error, Don-chan gains a stack of 'Perfect Pitch.' Each stack of 'Perfect Pitch' increases Don-chan's luck by 5, up to a maximum of 3 stacks. These stacks are lost if Don-chan fails a 'Rhythm Resonance' sequence. This passive rewards consistent, accurate play and encourages players to master the rhythmic input system for increased utility.
abilities.flavorQuote: Every beat counts!

character_v1.playstyle: Rhythm-based Support
character_v1.teamSynergy: Don-chan pairs well with damage-focused allies who benefit from increased attack damage and speed. His abilities provide both offensive and defensive support, making him a versatile addition to any team composition. Characters with high burst damage can benefit significantly from the 'Rhythmic Surge' buff, while those who rely on sustained damage can utilize the lifesteal provided by 'Sonic Symphony.'
character_v1.tierSummary: Don-Chan's reliance on 'Rhythm Resonance' for meaningful buffs and debuffs makes his kit inconsistent and easily countered, diminishing his buffer role. His single-target basic attack is underwhelming given the prevalence of AoE damage dealers, and his ultimate, while potent, is gated behind a rhythm mechanic vulnerable to disruption. Compared to other B-tier supports, Don-Chan's buff uptime and reliability are demonstrably lower, hindering his competitive viability. The 'Drumbeat Dynamo' and 'Sonic Symphony' combination represents his theoretical peak, but its practical application is severely limited by the rhythm gate. Ultimately, Don-Chan's kit lacks the consistent, impactful utility necessary to justify his selection in a competitive environment.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Don-chan's abilities are designed to synergize by rewarding accurate rhythm inputs. The passive ability 'Drumbeat Dynamo' enhances allies after successful sequences, while 'Tempo Tantrum' can disrupt enemies, creating opportunities for allies to capitalize on the chaos. 'Precision Performance' makes all other abilities slightly easier to perform. 'Sonic Symphony' can both buff allies and debuff enemies at the same time if performed correctly.

character_v1.playstyle: Combo-focused melee fighter who gains power from nearby allies and excels at protecting them.
character_v1.teamSynergy: Tatsuki synergizes well with teams that have auras or can consistently provide buffs to allies, maximizing the benefits of her 'Aura Echo' mechanic. character_v1.tierSummary: Tatsuki's S-tier bruiser status hinges on potent stat-scaling, particularly speed and defense, amplified by 'Aura Echo' across key abilities. 'Guardian's Stance' and 'Unwavering Protector' grant substantial defense and utility, but their effectiveness is conditional. While her kit offers good self-sustain and ally support, she's outclassed in raw damage compared to top-tier bruisers like Omniman and lacks the oppressive control of characters like Tao, rendering her dependent on specific team compositions to maintain viability despite favorable matchups.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Tatsuki's kit revolves around her ability to amplify her abilities through proximity to allies and to protect them when they are in danger, creating a synergy between her damage output and supportive capabilities.

This effect consumes all Bravado stacks upon activation.
abilities.flavorQuote: Elegance and agility, a deadly combination!

abilities.name: Leaping Lunge

This ability has a cooldown of 8 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: A swift strike from the shadows!

abilities.name: Cute Eyes
abilities.description: Puss in Boots displays his most charming expression, stunning all enemies in a cone in front of him for 1 second. Enemies affected by Cute Eyes have their attack damage reduced by 20% for 3 seconds after the stun ends. If Puss in Boots has 5 stacks of Bravado, the stun duration is increased to 1.5 seconds, and the damage reduction is increased to 30%. This ability has a cooldown of 12 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: Who can resist these eyes?

abilities.name: Swashbuckler's Flourish
abilities.description: Puss in Boots performs a series of rapid sword strikes, dealing a total of 120 (+60% atk) physical damage to enemies in a small area around him over 2 seconds. Each hit applies a stack of 'Bleed', dealing 5 (+2% atk) true damage per second for 3 seconds, stacking up to 5 times. Landing this ability grants Puss in Boots 2 stacks of Bravado. If Puss in Boots has 5 stacks of Bravado, Swashbuckler's Flourish also grants him a shield equal to 10% of his max HP for 4 seconds. This ability has a cooldown of 10 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: A whirlwind of steel and charm!

abilities.name: Legendary Hero
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
(Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~14% and slightly longer ramp-up.
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Puss in Boots channels his inner hero, gaining increased stats for 10 seconds. During this time, his attack damage is increased by 25%, his movement speed is increased by 15%, and he gains 3 stacks of Bravado instantly. Additionally, all basic abilities have their cooldowns reduced by 50% during this ultimate's duration. Activating this ultimate immediately grants Puss in Boots full stacks of Bravado. This ability has a cooldown of 75 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: My name... will become... LEGEND!

character_v1.playstyle: Mobile Skirmisher
character_v1.teamSynergy: Puss in Boots excels in teams that can capitalize on his crowd control and damage amplification. He synergizes well with burst damage dealers who can quickly eliminate stunned targets and with tanks who can provide frontline protection while he builds Bravado.
character_v1.tierSummary: Puss in Boots struggles in the A-tier controller landscape due to a kit that lacks definitive synergy; while 'Cute Eyes' provides crucial CC, its reliance as a primary control tool is easily countered. 'Dashing Duelist' offers marginal speed, failing to meaningfully impact his positioning or engagement. His damage output is inconsistent, relying heavily on 'Swashbuckler's Flourish', which is telegraphed and easily punished, unlike peers who offer more reliable zone control. 'Legendary Hero' attempts to compensate, but the buff duration is insufficient to overcome his core vulnerabilities, leaving him a situational pick overshadowed by more consistent options.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Puss in Boots' kit revolves around building and utilizing Bravado stacks. Leaping Lunge and Swashbuckler's Flourish both contribute to building these stacks, while Cute Eyes and Dashing Duelist benefit from having full stacks, creating a risk-reward dynamic that encourages aggressive play.

Enraged attacks gain 50% bonus damage and apply a stacking 'Terrified' debuff for 3 seconds, reducing the target's attack damage by 10% per stack, up to a maximum of 30%. The Enraged state lasts 5 seconds. After Enraging, Camp Dread is reset to 0. This passive encourages Jason to stay in the fight, absorbing damage and controlling the enemy, leading to a burst of empowered attacks.

If Jason is 'Enraged' from his passive, 'Relentless Pursuit', this ability also inflicts bleed, dealing X true damage over 5 seconds. This bleed damage will also grant Jason 1 stack of Camp Dread for each enemy affected. Machete Swing has a moderate cooldown, allowing Jason to consistently apply pressure and control the battlefield. Successfully hitting multiple enemies greatly accelerates the accumulation of 'Camp Dread', quickly triggering his enraged state.

The first enemy struck by Jason's brutal advance is immediately seized and brutally slashed, suffering X physical damage and becoming momentarily paralyzed by fear, stunned for 1.5 seconds. Should Jason latch onto a Hero, the sheer force of his malevolent grip grants him a shield that absorbs X damage for a duration of 3 seconds, reflecting his terrifying presence. This shield empowers his rage, granting 1 stack of Camp Dread every 0.5 seconds while the shield persists. The successful capture and assault triggers Jason's unnerving regenerative abilities, restoring Y health over 4 seconds and solidifying his position as a persistent and deadly threat. This sudden burst of violence makes Jason a terror to behold.

abilities.name: Unyielding Stalker
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~13% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Jason becomes unstoppable for 4 seconds, gaining 30% increased movement speed and ignoring all crowd control effects. During this time, he also gains damage reduction, mitigating 40% of incoming damage. Additionally, enemies within a certain radius of Jason become 'Feared', reducing their speed by 15% for the duration. This ability allows Jason to close the gap, reposition, or withstand heavy incoming damage. The slow effect further enhances his ability to control the battlefield. If Jason is 'Enraged' while activating this ability, nearby enemies are rooted for 1 second at the end of Unyielding Stalker.
abilities.flavorQuote: "You can't escape me."

abilities.name: Crystal Lake's Fury
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~8% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Jason channels the dark energy of Crystal Lake, becoming 'Empowered' for 8 seconds. While empowered, Jason gains 20% increased attack damage and his basic attacks cleave, dealing 40% of their damage to nearby enemies. Furthermore, each successful basic attack grants him 2 stacks of 'Camp Dread'. At the end of the empowered duration, Jason unleashes a devastating scream, fearing all nearby enemies for 2 seconds. If Jason reaches maximum Camp Dread stacks during this ultimate, the scream also deals X magic damage. The duration between his basic attacks are also dramatically reduced. This ability transforms Jason into a terrifying force, overwhelming enemies with increased damage and area-of-effect attacks.
abilities.flavorQuote: "Ki-ki-ki ma-ma-ma..."

character_v1.playstyle: Aggressive Tank/Crowd Control
character_v1.teamSynergy: Jason excels in teams that can capitalize on his crowd control and damage mitigation. He provides ample opportunities for damage dealers to focus fire on isolated or feared targets. He benefits from allies that can peel for him while he stacks Camp Dread, and supports that can enhance his survivability.
character_v1.tierSummary: Jason's kit suffers from poor synergy despite high individual ability value, failing to leverage 'Camp Dread' stacks effectively for sustained pressure. His reliance on Machete Swing for damage and Grasping Terror for initiation is telegraphed, making him vulnerable to zoning and burst. Compared to S-tier bruisers like Li, Tatsuki, and even Omniman on top tier, Jason lacks consistent, reliable damage output and is heavily reliant on landing key stuns, a significant weakness against faster, more mobile characters. Unyielding Stalker's short duration provides insufficient disruption or damage mitigation, while Crystal Lake's Fury's reliance on cleave damage proves less impactful than other bruisers with guaranteed burst options, relegating him to mid-tier viability at best within the context of the broader S-tier population.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Jason's kit revolves around building 'Camp Dread' through damage taken and crowd control, empowering his abilities and basic attacks. 'Relentless Pursuit' fuels his enraged state, while 'Machete Swing' and 'Grasping Terror' quickly generate stacks. 'Unyielding Stalker' allows for aggressive engagements and 'Crystal Lake's Fury' unleashes devastating damage and area control.

character_v1.playstyle: Burst Damage Support
character_v1.teamSynergy: Trunks provides strong burst damage potential and some utility through stuns and speed boosts. He synergizes well with teams that can capitalize on brief windows of opportunity or require a damage amplifier.
character_v1.tierSummary: Trunks' A-tier support placement is questionable; his kit lacks cohesive synergy compared to peers. 'Burning Stance' provides minimal value, failing to offer impactful protection for allies or significant self-sustain despite its scaling. 'Temporal Shift' offers brief escape utility but doesn't reliably enable team plays; it is outpaced by dedicated controllers and supports. 'Shining Sword Slash' is a niche burst option that poorly complements his supposed support role, creating split focus. His viability hinges almost entirely on 'Saiyan Lineage' augmenting his meager stats; absent significant external buffs, he's easily outclassed by more specialized units.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Trunks' kit is designed to empower his sword attacks through Temporal Surge. 'Saiyan Lineage' extends the duration of Temporal Surge, while 'Shining Sword Slash' benefits directly from its effects. 'Burning Attack' sets up enemies for increased sword damage.

character_v1.tierSummary: Android 18 excels in zone control, leveraging 'Destructo-Disc Field' to create persistent, damaging zones that synergize with 'Android Agility' for aggressive zoning and evasive maneuvers; 'Endless Energy' sustains her aggression, outlasting many similarly-ranked characters; however, her reliance on field placement makes her susceptible to characters with strong displacement or burst mobility; compared to top-tier controllers, her immediate crowd control is limited, positioning her slightly below the absolute meta.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Android 18's kit revolves around controlling space with her Energy Fields. Her abilities are designed to punish enemies who either ignore or destroy her fields, while simultaneously providing utility and buffs to her allies. Her passive ensures she remains a constant threat, even under pressure.

abilities.description: Unleash a devastating volley of miniature, super-compressed energy spheres, each a shimmering testament to Frieza's refined cruelty and mastery over Ki manipulation. Instead of a singular strike, Frieza rapidly generates and launches a multitude of these 'Death Comets' at a single target with unnerving precision. These projectiles, rather than impacting simultaneously, strike in rapid succession over a brief period of roughly one and a half seconds, creating a localized zone of chaotic energy bombardment. Each comet deals a moderate amount of physical damage, scaling primarily with Frieza's ATK stat and benefitting from critical hit chance and damage modifiers. However, the true strength of Death Comet Barrage lies in its persistent debuff application. Each successful hit from a Death Comet applies a stack of 'Ki Suppression' to the target. Each stack reduces the target's Ki regeneration rate by a small percentage (stacking multiplicatively to a maximum cap). Upon reaching a certain number of Ki Suppression stacks, the target suffers a brief period of 'Ki Disruption,' significantly increasing the cooldown of their next ability cast. Therefore, Death Comet Barrage is not merely a damage tool, but a tactical instrument designed to disrupt enemy combos, limit their offensive capabilities, and starve them of resources within Frieza's controlled zone, leaving them vulnerable to follow-up attacks and further exploitation. It's a display of overwhelming force disguised as a seemingly simple barrage, epitomizing Frieza's approach to combat: calculated, relentless, and utterly demoralizing. This ability reflects the visual of a golden aura surrounding the hand as small purple orbs are created and fired. After a moment, the ability goes on a moderate cooldown.
abilities.flavorQuote: Such a dazzling display of destruction, isn't it? Pity you're on the receiving end.

abilities.name: Planet Crushing Ball
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Frieza charges a massive energy sphere for 1.75 seconds (can be interrupted), which upon release, deals significant magic damage to a targeted area. The damage is increased by 1% for every 2 'Oppression' stacks Frieza possesses upon casting. Enemies at the center of the blast take 25% increased damage and are knocked back a moderate distance. This ability has a long cooldown. If Frieza is in Golden Form, this attack becomes instant cast and deals true damage equal to 10% of the target's current HP in addition to the magic damage.
abilities.flavorQuote: Say goodbye to your insignificant world!

abilities.name: My Golden Form!
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~17% and slightly longer ramp-up.
(Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~41%).
abilities.description: When the measure of Frieza's dominance, represented by 100 stacks of Oppression, is full, he can unleash his ultimate evolution, declaring to the lesser beings that he will show them his 'Golden Form!' For 10 glorious seconds, Frieza transcends his previous limitations. Initially, the transformation grants Frieza a brief invulnerability, a shimmering golden aura protecting him from all harm for 1.5 seconds, a testament to his absolute power. In this radiant state, Frieza's attacks strike with increased ferocity, his attack damage soaring by 25%, demonstrating the true extent of his evolved strength. Moreover, during the Golden Form, each of Frieza's abilities are augmented with additional, devastating effects. However, such power comes at a price. As the Golden Form fades, Frieza's body is wracked with 'Exhaustion', his speed and attack damage reduced by 15% for 5 seconds, a humbling reminder of his mortal coil. This ability has a very long cooldown.

abilities.name: Tyranny
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Tyranny's reach diminished: Peak potency reduced by approximately 12%, with a slightly extended ramp-up time to achieve maximum effect.
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
(Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~27%).
abilities.description: Frieza exudes an aura of absolute Tyranny, crushing the spirits of his foes and solidifying his dominance. Whenever Frieza inflicts a debuff upon an enemy champion, whether it be a slow, stun, or any other form of impairment, he gains 5 stacks of 'Tyranny', representing his tightening grip on the battlefield. Further demonstrating his overwhelming power, Frieza's basic attacks have a 20% chance to apply 'Suppression' to his target. 'Suppression' weakens the target, reducing their outgoing damage by 10% for a duration of 2 seconds, a period during which they are forced to endure Frieza's might. This 'Suppression' effect does not stack, preventing enemies from being completely nullified. Each critical strike Frieza lands grants him a burst of power, awarding him 2 additional stacks of 'Tyranny'. Finally, to cement his unwavering control, Frieza gains increased tenacity based on his stacks of 'Tyranny'. For every 10 stacks he accumulates, his tenacity is increased by 1%, with a maximum possible increase of 10% tenacity, representing his near-unbreakable will.

character_v1.playstyle: Punishing aggressors and controlling space through debuffs and calculated bursts of power with Golden Frieza transformation.
character_v1.teamSynergy: Frieza synergizes well with team compositions that can amplify his zone control or provide crowd control to set up his Planet Crushing Ball. Allies that can apply additional debuffs or peel for him during the Exhaustion phase after Golden Form are highly beneficial. Frieza also benefits from allies who can capitalize on the increased damage vulnerability inflicted by his 'Fragile' debuff during his Golden form.
character_v1.tierSummary: Frieza's oppressive zoning kit, defined by 'Death Beam Barrage' and 'Planet Crushing Ball', allows unmatched area control; however, the reliance on 'Oppression' stacks for 'My Golden Form!' introduces a critical vulnerability to tenacity-stacking compositions. Compared to fellow S-tiers like Android 18 and other zone control specialists, Frieza's delayed burst and interruptible nuke telegraphs his intentions, creating counterplay windows. This predictability, combined with the current meta favoring high-mobility assassins like Tao and Omniman, who can bypass his zoning, limits his overall effectiveness despite raw damage output. Therefore, while his theoretical damage is high, practical application requires careful positioning and team support to mitigate his clear weaknesses in the current landscape.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Frieza's kit revolves around building Oppression stacks quickly through debuffs and damage. The core gameplay loop involves using Death Beam Barrage and Emperor's Pressure to debuff enemies, generating Oppression, and then unleashing the Planet Crushing Ball for significant damage. Golden Tyrant provides a temporary window for enhanced damage output and invulnerability, rewarding aggressive plays and punishing enemies who engage him during this phase.

abilities.description: Knuckles calls upon the power of Angel Island, creating a localized avalanche around himself. Knuckles is immune to crowd control effects during this ability. This ability has a 90 second cooldown. While channeling Angel Island Avalanche, Knuckles' Guardian Stance damage reduction is increased by an additional 10%. This ability will target the area with the highest concentration of enemies.

When Knuckles is above 75% of max hp, he will also gain X atk.

character_v1.playstyle: Knuckles is a bruiser focused on dealing consistent damage and disrupting the enemy team with physical attacks. His Guardian Stance passive makes him more resilient as he takes damage, allowing him to stay in the fight longer and protect his allies.
character_v1.teamSynergy: Knuckles benefits from allies who can provide healing or further crowd control, allowing him to stay in the fight longer and maximize his damage output. Allies that benefit from a strong frontline presence synergize well with Knuckles.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Knuckles' kit revolves around his ability to disrupt enemies with punches and digging, while his Guardian Stance and Echidna Resilience increase his survivability, making him more dangerous as he takes damage. Angel Island Avalanche benefits from Knuckles being in the middle of a fight.

abilities.description: Tao summons a barrage of spectral flying swords that autonomously strike nearby enemies. Upon activation, Tao consumes 10% of her current ammo, summoning 3 swords that each deal X physical damage to the nearest enemy within 10 meters, prioritizing enemies marked by Fatal Bloom. Each sword homes in on its target, dealing damage three times in rapid succession. The damage scales with her attack stat and is further increased by 5% per stack of Blade Heart, up to a maximum of 50 stacks. Swords Out has a cooldown of 8 seconds, which is reduced by 0.1 seconds for each Blade Heart stack consumed upon activation. If no enemies are within range, the swords orbit Tao, providing a shield equal to 10% of her max HP, decaying over 3 seconds.

abilities.name: Fatal Bloom: Lingering Wound
upgrades: Level 30: Increases the base magic damage by 25%.
Level 80: Fatal Bloom now also reduces the target's healing received by 10% per stack of Lingering Wound.
Level 130: The cooldown reduction per Blade Heart stack is increased to 0.3 seconds. Fatal Bloom's mark now lasts 7 seconds.
Level 180: When a target reaches 5 stacks of Lingering Wound, Tao gains a stack of Blade Heart.
Level 200: Fully stacked Lingering Wound now also applies a 2 second Silence to the target.
abilities.description: Tao throws a spectral bloom that marks a single target within 15 meters, inflicting a stacking debuff. The initial mark deals X magic damage and applies 'Lingering Wound', causing the target to take 3% increased damage from all sources for 5 seconds. This debuff can stack up to 5 times, increasing the damage taken to 15%. The mark also amplifies the effectiveness of Swords Out, causing the swords to prioritize the marked target. If the target is already marked, the duration is refreshed and an additional stack is added if possible. Fatal Bloom has a cooldown of 6 seconds, which is reduced by 0.2 seconds for each Blade Heart stack. Activating Fatal Bloom consumes 5 Blade Heart stacks, granting Tao 10% increased movement speed for 3 seconds upon successful application of the mark.

abilities.name: Blade Heart Resonance: Relentless Offense
upgrades: Level 40: Blade Heart stacks now also grant 0.5% increased movement speed, up to a maximum of 25%.
Level 90: Reduces the required ammo consumption to gain a stack of Blade Heart to 4%.
Level 140: Blade Heart Resonance now also grants Tao a 20% critical hit chance for 5 seconds.
Level 190: The maximum Blade Heart stacks are increased to 75, increasing the maximum bonus attack and magic attack to 75%.
Level 200: Blade Heart Resonance now provides immunity to crowd control effects for the duration of its effect.
abilities.description: Tao gains a stack of Blade Heart for every 5% of her magazine capacity consumed by her weapon attacks. Each stack of Blade Heart grants 1% increased attack and magic attack, up to a maximum of 50 stacks. When Tao reaches the maximum number of stacks, she gains 'Blade Heart Resonance', causing her next Swords Out to consume all Blade Heart stacks and deal an additional 2% true damage per stack consumed. Additionally, each Blade Heart stack grants Tao 1% increased shield regeneration rate, up to a maximum of 50%. This passive encourages an aggressive playstyle, rewarding high ammo consumption with increased damage and survivability, allowing Tao to maintain consistent pressure on her enemies.

abilities.name: Blade Heart Tempest: Unleashed Destruction
upgrades: Level 125: Extends the duration of Blade Heart Tempest to 12 seconds.
Level 150: The damage dealt at the end of Blade Heart Tempest is increased by 30%.
Level 175: During Blade Heart Tempest, Tao gains 20% increased attack and magic attack.
Level 200: Upon activation, Blade Heart Tempest cleanses all debuffs from Tao and grants her immunity to new debuffs for the duration.
abilities.description: Tao unleashes the full potential of her Blade Heart stacks, entering a state of heightened combat awareness for 10 seconds. During this time, the cost of Swords Out is reduced to 5% current ammo, and the cooldown is reduced by 50%. Additionally, Fatal Bloom’s damage amplification is increased to 5% per stack of Lingering Wound. Activating Blade Heart Tempest consumes all current Blade Heart stacks, granting Tao a shield equal to 2% of her maximum HP per stack consumed, lasting for the duration of the ultimate. At the end of the ultimate, Tao releases a final surge of energy, dealing X magic damage to all enemies within 15 meters, scaling with the number of Blade Heart stacks consumed during the ultimate's activation. This ultimate provides Tao with unparalleled burst damage and survivability, making her a force to be reckoned with on the battlefield.

abilities.name: Resilient Flourish: Swift Recovery
upgrades: Level 100: Increases the amount of HP recovered to 7% of maximum HP.
Level 150: The duration of the tenacity buff is increased to 7 seconds.
Level 200: When Tao falls below 30% HP, she instantly gains a full stack of Blade Heart, and her evasion bonus upon shield break is increased to 20%.
abilities.description: Whenever Tao triggers Fatal Bloom's mark on an unmarked target, she recovers 5% of her maximum HP and gains 10 tenacity for 5 seconds, stacking up to 3 times. Additionally, when Tao's shield is broken, she gains 15% increased evasion for 3 seconds. Her base tenacity is increased by 10 and her base evasion is increased by 5. This signature passive provides Tao with additional sustain and survivability, allowing her to stay in the fight longer and recover from critical hits, enhancing her role as a resilient assassin capable of trading blows effectively.

character_v1.playstyle: Tao is designed as a high-risk, high-reward assassin that uses ammo consumption to power up her abilities and deliver devastating burst damage. Her kit revolves around stacking Blade Heart through aggressive play, then capitalizing on those stacks to enhance her Swords Out and Fatal Bloom skills. This requires precise timing and resource management to maximize her effectiveness in combat.
character_v1.teamSynergy: Tao excels in teams that can provide sustained damage and crowd control, allowing her to focus on eliminating high-priority targets. Allies that can buff her attack and magic attack further amplify her burst potential, while those that can provide shields can help her maintain Blade Heart stacks more consistently.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Tao's abilities are heavily intertwined through the Blade Heart mechanic. Consuming ammo feeds into Blade Heart stacks, which amplify her damage output with Swords Out and Fatal Bloom. The ultimate provides an explosive release of her accumulated Blade Heart, incentivizing aggressive play and resource management.

Whenever an enemy is affected by two or more unique elemental effects (e.g., Decay and Corrosion), Crown Prince's basic attacks and abilities deal an additional 20% magic damage to that enemy. Additionally, Crown Prince gains 10% increased shield regeneration rate. This passive constantly monitors the status effects on enemies.

abilities.name: Spirit Realm Purification
upgrades: Level 150: Damage increased to 300 (+120% Magic Atk).
Level 200: Cooldown reduced to 60 seconds, and the cone area is widened by 20%.
abilities.description: Crown Prince channels the power of the Spirit Realm, unleashing a wave of elemental energy in a cone-shaped area in front of him. This wave deals 200 (+80% Magic Atk) magic damage and applies all available elemental effects (Decay, Corrosion, Burn, Shock, Freeze) to all enemies within the area for 5 seconds. Furthermore, enemies affected by this ability take 30% increased damage from all sources for the duration. This ability has a cooldown of 90 seconds and prioritizes enemies within the cone.

abilities.name: Alchemical Resilience
upgrades: Level 125: Tenacity increased to 45 and debuff cleanse chance increased to 35%.
Level 175: Elemental effects applied by Crown Prince have a 10% chance to also inflict a stacking 'Weakened' debuff, reducing the target's armor and magic resistance by 5% per stack (max 3 stacks).
abilities.description: Crown Prince's alchemical prowess grants him enhanced resilience. He gains 30 Tenacity, reducing the duration of incoming crowd control effects by 30%. Additionally, whenever Crown Prince applies an elemental effect to an enemy, he has a 25% chance to cleanse one random debuff from himself. This effect can only occur once every 8 seconds. Furthermore Crown Prince's base magic resistance is increased by 15.

character_v1.playstyle: Crown Prince is designed as a utility-focused character who excels at enabling elemental damage for his team. While he can deal damage himself, his primary function is to apply Decay and other elemental statuses, amplifying the damage output of allies who can capitalize on these effects.
character_v1.teamSynergy: Crown Prince excels in teams that can capitalize on elemental effects. His ability to apply Decay, Corrosion, and other elemental statuses makes him a valuable asset to any team composition that includes characters with elemental damage or abilities that synergize with status effects. The increased damage vulnerability from Spirit Realm Purification benefits the entire team, allowing for coordinated bursts of damage.
character_v1.internalSynergy: The kit revolves around applying multiple elemental effects to enemies using Energy Orb Barrage and Smoke Grenade Deployment, which then synergizes with Elemental Attunement to increase Crown Prince's damage output. Spirit Realm Purification serves as a powerful ultimate, applying all elemental effects and significantly increasing damage vulnerability, setting up enemies for massive burst damage from Crown Prince and his team.

character_v1.playstyle: Li's kit heavily emphasizes applying and benefiting from the 'Burning' status effect, allowing her to serve as a Fire-damage-focused bruiser. character_v1.teamSynergy: Li synergizes well with other fire-based characters who can consistently apply 'Burning' to enemies, allowing her to quickly build 'Scorched Earth' stacks and maximize her damage output. Characters that can group enemies together also enhance the effectiveness of 'Blazing Meteor' and 'Crimson Nova'.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Li's kit revolves around building and maintaining 'Scorched Earth' stacks by applying 'Burning' to enemies, which then empowers her 'Spiritual Flame' and 'Blazing Meteor' abilities. 'Flame Talisman' offers defensive utility by consuming stacks for damage reduction, while 'Crimson Nova' expends all stacks for a burst of damage and self-buffs, creating a risk-reward playstyle.

abilities.description: Richard, with a barely perceptible shift in his stoic expression, designates a target area for a concentrated bombardment of LEGO studs. These hard plastic projectiles descend upon the marked zone, dealing a total of 80 magic damage, enhanced by 60% of Richard's magic attack power, to any unfortunate enemies caught within the circular zone over a duration of 3 seconds. The area targeted is intelligently selected, prioritizing locations where enemy presence is most dense, ensuring maximum impact. The damage unfolds in a series of rapid ticks, granting enemies fleeting moments to evade the full brunt of the stud storm. Should Richard possess a Royal Decree exceeding 50, the studs are imbued with a binding adhesive, inflicting 'Bricked' upon impact, hindering enemy movement by reducing their speed by 25% for 2 seconds, simulating the frustrating experience of stepping on a LEGO brick. Furthermore, each activation of Stud Barrage replenishes Richard's strategic reserves, granting him 10 Royal Decree. This ability operates on a 10-second cooldown, allowing for calculated deployment in the heat of battle.

This decree echoes with the authority of Unikingdom, provided Richard's Royal Decree is high enough; if Richard currently possesses more than 50 Royal Decree, the shielded ally also benefits from a 15% increase in their attack power for the shield's duration. This ability operates on a 12-second cooldown. The shield's effectiveness diminishes gradually, decaying by 25% of its original value each second. Only one Royal Decree shield can be active on an ally at any given time; should a new shield be applied, it overwrites the previous one. The sheer monotony of Richard's decree is strangely distracting, causing enemies to momentarily falter, granting all allies a 5% evasion buff for 2 seconds following the shield's application. character_v1.playstyle: Richard excels at providing utility and control by buffing allies with 'Rules' and hindering enemies with 'Chores'. His kit revolves around managing Royal Decree to enhance his support capabilities and maintain order on the battlefield, embodying his role as Unikitty's royal advisor.
character_v1.teamSynergy: Richard synergizes well with teams that benefit from atk speed buffs and defensive support. His shields and Def aura provide crucial protection, while his debuffs can disrupt enemy formations and reduce their damage output. He is particularly effective with damage-focused allies who can capitalize on the increased atk speed provided by his ultimate.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Richard's kit synergizes around managing Royal Decree, which enhances his abilities to either buff allies or debuff enemies. His passive ability to gain Royal Decree when allies are affected by negative status effects allows him to consistently empower his abilities. His ultimate consumes Royal Decree to create a powerful zoning effect, further amplifying his support capabilities.

Level 75: Knockback distance increased by 50 base units. Stun duration increased to 1.5 seconds when at max 'Cartoon Physics' stacks.
Level 125: Now grants Tom a shield equal to 10% of his Max HP for 3 seconds after casting, scaling with 'Cartoon Physics' stacks (2% per stack).
Level 175: 'Cartoon Physics' cap increased to 7 stacks.
(Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~11%).
(Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~31%).
abilities.description: Tom winds up and slams a comically large mallet in a target direction, dealing 100 + (0.3 * X) physical damage to all enemies in a 300-unit radius. Enemies hit are also knocked back 150 units. For each stack of 'Cartoon Physics' Tom has, the radius of this attack increases by 25 units, and the knockback distance increases by 10 units. Tom gains one stack of 'Cartoon Physics' whenever he is struck by an enemy ability, to a maximum of 5 stacks. If Tom has 5 stacks of 'Cartoon Physics', this ability also applies a 1 second Stun to enemies hit.

abilities.name: Frantic Flourish
upgrades: Lv10: Increases evasion window and debuff duration.
Lv50: Now heals allies for a small amount at the end of the flourish, based on damage evaded.
Lv100: Adds a chance to reflect projectiles back at attackers during the flourish.
abilities.description: Frantic Flourish is a spectacle of accidental tanking. Upon activation, Tom initiates a series of exaggerated, seemingly panicked movements—a chaotic dance designed to both protect allies and disrupt enemies. During the Flourish, Tom's evasion stat receives a significant boost, allowing him to dodge incoming attacks with surprising (and wholly unintentional) grace. More than that, the sheer unpredictability of Tom's Flourish applies the 'Distracted' debuff, reducing the target's damage output and focus. Visually, expect flailing limbs, cartoonish dust clouds, and perhaps even a misplaced piano key or two. The duration of the evasion buff and the effectiveness of the distraction status is calculated through scaling factors tied to Tom's DEF and HP, improving its overall utility as the character grows.
abilities.flavorQuote: I'm not panicking, you're panicking!

abilities.name: Inescapable Antagonism: The Enduring Chase
upgrades: Level 40: Evasion chance increased to 20%.
Level 90: 'Frenzy' duration increased to 5 seconds. Movement speed bonus increased to 7% per stack.
Level 140: Taunt duration increased to 1.5 seconds.
Level 190: When Tom is at max frenzy, he gains immunity to knockback and displacement effects for 3 seconds.
abilities.description: Tom has a 15% chance to evade incoming physical damage. When Tom evades an attack, he gains a stack of 'Frenzy', increasing his movement speed by 5% and attack speed by 10% for 4 seconds, stacking up to 3 times. Additionally, for every stack of 'Cartoon Physics' he has, Tom gains 5 additional tenacity, allowing him to resist crowd control effects more effectively. This tenacity bonus is calculated before other tenacity modifiers. When Tom reaches max stacks of frenzy, he lets out a howl, taunting nearby enemies for 1 second.

abilities.name: Tom's Ingenious Contraption Cascade: The Rube Goldberg Rampage
upgrades: Level 60: Projectile damage increased to 75 + (0.15 * X). Number of hits increased to 7.
Level 110: Explosion damage increased to 400 + (0.75 * X).
Level 160: Magnet duration increased to 3 seconds, and pull strength increased by 25%.
Level 200: During the machine-building phase, the increased damage taken is reduced to 15%. After the explosion, a small heal, worth 5% max health, is applied to allies
abilities.description: Tom spends 2 seconds building a complex Rube Goldberg machine. During this time, he's immune to crowd control but takes 25% increased damage. Once completed, the machine triggers a chain reaction of cartoonish events over 8 seconds. For the first 3 seconds, random projectiles (hammers, anvils, pies) rain down in a large area (500 units), dealing 50 + (0.1 * X) magic damage per hit (max 5 hits per enemy). Then, a giant magnet activates for 2 seconds, pulling enemies towards the center. Finally, a massive explosion occurs, dealing 300 + (0.6 * X) magic damage in the center and knocking enemies upwards. If Tom has max stacks of 'Cartoon Physics' when activating this ability, the machine also dispenses a random buff to allies within the rain zone, either granting a 25% damage boost or a 20% movement speed increase for 5 seconds.

abilities.name: Cartoon Resilience: The Slapstick Savior
upgrades: Level 45: Bonus Def increased to 75, and Magic Def increased to 45.
Level 95: Movement speed during 'Cartoon Recovery' increased to 35%.
Level 145: 'Cartoon Recovery' cooldown reduced to 45 seconds base. The tenacity is tripled instead of doubled
Level 195: 'Cartoon Recovery' now also cleanses all negative status effects from Tom.
abilities.description: Tom's inherent cartoon logic grants him increased durability. He gains 50 bonus Def and 30 bonus Magic Def. Furthermore, when Tom's HP drops below 20%, he triggers 'Cartoon Recovery'. During 'Cartoon Recovery', Tom becomes invulnerable for 1 second, gains 25% increased movement speed, and his tenacity is doubled. This effect has a 60-second cooldown. For each stack of 'Cartoon Physics' Tom possesses at the time 'Cartoon Recovery' triggers, the invulnerability duration is increased by 0.2 seconds, and the cooldown is reduced by 2 seconds. Also, he gains 10 base tenacity.

character_v1.playstyle: Tom is a disruptive tank who thrives in the middle of chaos, using his cartoonish resilience to draw enemy fire and set up opportunities for his team. He's best played aggressively, constantly moving and forcing enemies to react to his unpredictable antics.
character_v1.teamSynergy: Tom excels at disrupting enemy formations and providing temporary openings for his team. He pairs well with damage dealers who can capitalize on his knockbacks and stuns, as well as supports who can keep him alive while he accumulates 'Cartoon Physics' stacks.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Tom's kit is designed to synergize around 'Cartoon Physics'. Getting hit empowers his Mallet Mayhem, strengthens his traps, and enhances his ultimate. The passive provides sustain and escape, while the ultimate provides high-impact AoE disruption.

abilities.name: Spring-Loaded Surprise: Strategic Trap Placement
upgrades: Level 25: Trap duration increased to 20 seconds.
Level 75: Damage increased to 90 + (0.6 * X magic atk).
Level 125: Adds a Slow effect (30%) for 2 seconds after the Stun ends.
Level 175: Trap now has a chance (30%) to drop a random Acquired Item near the launched enemy.
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Jerry cleverly places a spring-loaded trap at a target location within a medium range. Upon activation by an enemy unit stepping within its small radius, the trap launches them a short distance in a direction away from Jerry, inflicting 60 + (0.4 * X magic atk) physical damage and applying a 1.5 second Stun. The trap remains active for 15 seconds before disappearing if not triggered. Only two traps can be active at a time; placing a third will remove the oldest one. This ability has a cooldown of 10 seconds, modified by any item effects that reduce cooldowns. Priority targets are enemies moving predictably or those clumped together, maximizing the impact of the launch and stun. The placement range is affected by Jerry's line of sight, preventing placement through walls.

abilities.name: Pocket Full of Tricks: Acquired Item Toss
upgrades: Level 30: Adds a new item: a small firecracker dealing 60 + (0.3 * X magic atk) Fire damage in a small AoE.
Level 80: Increases the effectiveness of all items by 20% (e.g., increased heal, increased stun duration).
Level 130: Cooldown reduced to 6 seconds.
Level 180: Adds a new item: a 'Smoke Bomb' that Blinds enemies for 2.5 seconds.
abilities.description: Jerry rummages through his 'Acquired Items' and throws a random one at a targeted enemy or ally within a medium range. The effect of the item depends on what Jerry finds: Cheese applies a 2-second Charm to enemies, distracting them. A small Mallet deals 80 + (0.5 * X atk) physical damage and applies a 1-second Stun. A vial of 'Miracle-Gro' heals an ally for 100 + (0.4 * X magic atk) health. The chance of each item appearing is equal. Consumes the item upon use. If Jerry has no Acquired Items, the ability does nothing. The ability has a cooldown of 8 seconds. Prioritize using the Mallet on high-threat targets and the Miracle-Gro on low-health allies. The toss has travel time, requiring lead time to aim.

abilities.name: Nimble Escapist: Fleet-Footed Furtivity
upgrades: Level 40: Increases speed bonus to 20% and evasion chance to 15%.
Level 90: When Jerry evades an attack, he gains a temporary shield equal to 5% of his max HP for 3 seconds.
Level 140: Increases the maximum number of 'Acquired Items' Jerry can hold to 4.
Level 190: Adds a new Acquired Item to the random pool: a 'Fake Bomb' that does no damage but applies Fear to enemies.
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Jerry's natural agility grants him a 15% bonus to his speed and a 10% chance to evade incoming basic attacks. Additionally, whenever an enemy triggers one of Jerry's Spring-Loaded Surprise traps, Jerry gains an 'Acquired Item'. This item will be one of the following, chosen at random: Cheese, Mallet, Miracle-Gro or Firecracker. This passive ability provides Jerry with increased survivability and resources, allowing him to continuously disrupt and support his team. Prioritize positioning Jerry near trap zones to maximize the item acquisition rate. These items persist until used. He can hold a maximum of 3 Acquired Items at any time; further procs are lost if full.

abilities.name: Mouse Mayhem: Ultimate Distraction Fiesta
upgrades: Level 60: Increases the duration of Mouse Mayhem to 10 seconds.
Level 110: Adds a 15% chance for enemies to be briefly Taunted towards Jerry during the effect.
Level 160: Allies within the area also gain a small shield equal to 5% of their max HP every 2 seconds.
Level 200: Reduces cooldown to 75 seconds and increases the speed bonus to allies to 30%.
abilities.description: Jerry unleashes a chaotic flurry of distractions, targeting a large area around him. For 8 seconds, enemies within the area are periodically affected by random status effects: 40% chance to be Charmed for 1 second, 30% chance to be Slowed by 50% for 2 seconds, and a 30% chance to be Blinded for 1 second. Allies within the area gain 20% increased speed and 10% increased damage. This ability has a long cooldown of 90 seconds. Prioritize using Mouse Mayhem in the middle of team fights to maximize disruption and buff potential. The speed buff stacks multiplicatively with Jerry's passive. Each application of a debuff is independent of the others.

abilities.name: Unseen Agility: Mouse Reflexes and Tenacity
upgrades: Level 85: Increases evasion bonus to 35 and tenacity bonus to 25.
Level 135: Successfully evading an attack now also grants Jerry a 10% speed boost for 3 seconds.
Level 185: The free 'Spring-Loaded Surprise' trap placement effect duration increases to 7 seconds.
Level 200: Jerry's tenacity reduces damage taken from status effects by an additional 10%.
abilities.description: Jerry's inherent agility grants him a permanent increase of 25 to his base evasion and 15 to his base tenacity stats, making him harder to hit and more resistant to crowd control effects. Whenever Jerry successfully evades an attack, his next 'Spring-Loaded Surprise' trap placement is instant and costs no mana/energy. This effect lasts for 5 seconds. This ability directly improves Jerry's survivability and ability to chain traps, allowing him to maintain battlefield control more effectively. Prioritize building additional tenacity to further reduce the duration of crowd control effects. Note that the free trap placement does not stack.

character_v1.playstyle: Jerry is designed as a versatile utility character, focusing on battlefield control, item manipulation, and opportunistic disruption. He uses traps and acquired items to hinder enemies and empower allies, requiring careful planning and resource management.
character_v1.teamSynergy: Jerry excels in teams that can capitalize on enemy displacement and crowd control. His traps and items can set up opportunities for burst damage dealers, while his ultimate ability can disrupt enemy formations and provide buffs to allies, enhancing overall team effectiveness.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Jerry's kit is designed around trap placement and item usage. The passive ability provides a continuous source of items, which can then be used with the active ability. The ultimate ability provides a wide-area distraction, creating opportunities for trap placement and item usage.

abilities.description: Kakashi channels a high concentration of lightning chakra into his hand, dashing a short distance and dealing massive physical damage to the first enemy hit. This attack has a short cooldown. The Lightning Blade deals X + (0.8 * atk) physical damage, ignoring 20% of the target's defense. If Kakashi has 3 Copy Charges, he consumes them to enhance the Lightning Blade, increasing the damage to X + (1.2 * atk) and stunning the target for 1.5 seconds. This dash distance is short, roughly equivalent to 2 character widths, making careful positioning crucial for landing the attack effectively.

abilities.name: Water Style: Great Waterfall Technique
upgrades: Level 30: Increases the size of the area of effect by 15%.
Level 80: Reduces the cooldown of this ability by 1 second.
Level 130: Increases the damage of the waterfall to X + (0.9 * magic atk).
Level 180: If the target is also affected by Chidori's 'Electrocute' status, the Water Style jutsu deals an additional burst of X + (0.4 * magic atk) electric damage.
Level 200: Upon casting, Kakashi gains 1 Copy Charge (up to the maximum).
abilities.description: Kakashi summons a massive wave of water to crash down on a targeted area, dealing magic damage and slowing enemies caught within the torrent. This ability has a moderate cooldown. The waterfall deals X + (0.7 * magic atk) magic damage in a large area and applies a 30% slow for 3 seconds. If Kakashi has at least 1 Copy Charge, he consumes 1 charge to enhance the Water Style jutsu: the slow effect is increased to 50%, and it also reduces the target's magic defense by 15% for 5 seconds. The area targeted is circular, roughly 5 character widths in diameter, allowing for good zone control and set-up for other abilities.

abilities.name: Copy Wheel Eye: Tactical Adaptation
upgrades: Level 40: Increases the maximum number of Copy Charges to 7.
Level 90: The duration to analyze the enemy team is reduced to 20 seconds.
Level 140: Increases the magic atk/atk bonus per unique enemy type to 7.5%.
Level 190: Copy charges are now also gained when an ally uses an ability, but at half rate (0.5 charges, rounded down)
Level 200: Kakashi gains 10 tenacity for every 2 copy charges he has.
abilities.description: Kakashi's Sharingan passively analyzes enemies. Whenever an enemy uses an ability, Kakashi gains 1 Copy Charge (max 5). These charges can be consumed to enhance other abilities. Additionally, Kakashi gains 5% increased magic atk and atk for each unique enemy type on the battlefield (e.g., different franchise). This passive provides a continuous tactical advantage, rewarding strategic play based on the enemy team composition. At the start of the match, and every 30 seconds thereafter, Kakashi analyzes the enemy team, potentially granting bonus starting Copy Charges.

abilities.name: Mangekyo Sharingan: Kamui Raid
upgrades: Level 110: Increases the duration of the Mangekyo Sharingan by 2 seconds.
Level 150: Reduces the cooldown of this ability by 10 seconds.
Level 170: Kamui Seal now also silences the target for 2 seconds.
Level 190: During Mangekyo Sharingan, Kakashi gains 2 Copy Charges every 3 seconds.

Level 200: While under the effects of Mangekyo Sharingan, Kakashi can use 'Kamui Shuriken', consuming all remaining duration, throwing a shuriken that deals X + (1.5 * magic atk) damage in a line, and the shuriken's path removes all buffs/shields from enemies hit.
(Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~13% and slightly longer ramp-up.
(Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~13% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Kakashi activates his Mangekyo Sharingan, gaining increased speed and access to Kamui for a short duration. During this time, he can use 'Kamui Teleport' to teleport behind a targeted enemy, dealing heavy magic damage and applying a 'Kamui Seal'. Enemies sealed by Kamui have reduced speed and evasion for 7 seconds. This ability has a long cooldown and drains Kakashi's HP for 10% of his max HP upon activation, reflecting the strain of using the Mangekyo Sharingan. Kamui Teleport deals X + (1.0 * magic atk) magic damage. Kakashi gains 20% increased speed and 30% increased evasion during the Mangekyo Sharingan duration.

abilities.name: Thousand Jutsu Master: Adaptive Tenacity
upgrades: Level 100: Increases the evasion gained per unique jutsu type to 4% (max 20%).
Level 150: Increases the duration reduction of stuns/slows/burns to 30%.
Level 175: If Kakashi is reduced to below 20% of his max hp he will automatically use one copy charge to shield himself for 10% of his max hp for 4 seconds (can only occur once every 20 seconds).
Level 200: Kakashi permanently has 5 additional tenacity, regardless of Jutsu types copied.
abilities.description: Kakashi, the copy ninja, gains 3% evasion for every unique Jutsu type he has copied through 'Copy Wheel Eye' during the match, up to a maximum of 15%. Furthermore, if Kakashi has any copy charges when he is inflicted with a stun, slow or burn, he will consume one charge to reduce its duration by 20%. The accumulated wealth of copied techniques grants Kakashi increased resilience and adaptability in combat. The Jutsu Types are defined as: Fire Release, Water Release, Earth Release, Wind Release, Lightning Release, Physical Enhancements, Genjutsu, Healing, Summons. The use of Kamui does not grant a unique Jutsu type. At the start of each match, Kakashi immediately starts with one Jutsu Type copied.

character_v1.playstyle: Kakashi is a versatile Adaptive Specialist, excelling at disrupting enemy formations and copying key enemy abilities to turn the tide of battle. He thrives in prolonged engagements, gaining power as he analyzes his opponents and adapts his strategies.
character_v1.teamSynergy: Kakashi synergizes well with teams that can capitalize on his area control and disruptions. Allies that can deal high burst damage or follow up on slowed or sealed targets benefit greatly from his kit. His team buff also aids in prolonged fights.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Kakashi's kit revolves around building up Copy Charges to empower his ninjutsu. The passive grants a strong sense of adaptability, while Kamui Raid offers burst damage and disruption. The signature passive reinforces his role as a resilient and adaptive combatant.

abilities.description: Sasuke's Sharingan grants him increased tactical awareness in combat. Sasuke gains stacks of Sharingan Insight whenever he lands an ability on an enemy (max 3 stacks). Each stack of Sharingan Insight grants 5% increased critical hit chance and 3% increased damage against enemies afflicted with a status effect. Additionally, when an enemy is afflicted with Electrified or Burn, Sasuke gains 3% increased Evasion for 5 seconds. abilities.name: Kirin: Lightning Blade of Divine Judgement
upgrades: Level 150: Reduces Kirin's cooldown to 75 seconds.

abilities.description: Sasuke manipulates the natural lightning in the atmosphere, channeling it into a concentrated strike. Sasuke calls down a massive bolt of lightning on a target area, dealing magic damage equal to X + (1.2 * magic atk) to all enemies within. Enemies afflicted with 'Electrified' take 50% increased damage from this ability and are stunned for 1.5 seconds. After Kirin is cast, Sasuke's next ability has no cooldown, reflecting Sasuke's decisive follow-up attacks. This ability has a long cooldown of 90 seconds.

abilities.name: Indra's Arrow: The Pinnacle of Uchiha Power
upgrades: Level 175: Increase Tenacity to 20% and Evasion to 15%.
Level 200: Landing a Critical Strike extends the duration of Indra's Charge by 1 second, up to a maximum of 10 seconds total.
abilities.description: Sasuke's mastery over chakra and the Sharingan allows him to achieve unparalleled feats. Sasuke gains 15% Tenacity and 10% Evasion. Furthermore, whenever Sasuke reaches 3 stacks of Sharingan Insight, he gains the 'Indra's Charge' buff for 7 seconds. While Indra's Charge is active, Sasuke's critical hits deal 50% increased damage. If Sasuke lands 5 critical hits during 'Indra's Charge', this bonus damage becomes 100% for the remaining duration.

character_v1.playstyle: Sasuke is a damage dealer, focusing on burst damage and zone control through Ninjutsu. His 'Sharingan Insight' mechanic rewards tactical ability usage and target prioritization, amplifying his damage output against key enemies.
character_v1.teamSynergy: Sasuke benefits from team compositions that can apply additional status effects, allowing him to capitalize on his damage bonus. Characters who can provide crowd control or additional damage amplification synergize well with his high burst potential.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Sasuke's kit revolves around applying and capitalizing on status effects, particularly 'Electrified'. Chidori and Gokakyu interact directly, and his passive significantly boosts his damage when status effects are present. The ultimate acts as both burst and setup, ensuring the passive reaches its full potential.

abilities.description: Buttercup channels her unparalleled fury into a devastating whirlwind of motion, becoming a nigh-unstoppable force of pure, green-tinged aggression! Upon activation, Buttercup rapidly transforms into a tightly coiled, emerald blur and launches herself forward a moderate distance, leaving a shimmering green afterimage in her wake. During this period of frenzied motion, she becomes momentarily immune to crowd control effects, shrugging off attempts to impede her destructive path with a contemptuous snarl. Any enemy foolish enough to stand in her way is subjected to a relentless barrage of bone-jarring impacts, each strike dealing a calculated amount of physical damage that scales multiplicatively with Buttercup's raw ATK and her current Fury level. Moreover, each successful hit has a chance to inflict a short-duration stacking debuff which lowers their total defense, making them increasingly vulnerable to subsequent attacks. At the end of the roll, or upon colliding with an unyielding obstacle, Buttercup erupts from her green shell, unleashing a concussive shockwave that knocks back nearby enemies. This ability also generates a modest amount of Fury, fueling her other abilities and amplifying her overall combat prowess, embodying her signature impetuousness and sheer, unadulterated power. But beware, this move leaves her briefly vulnerable at the tail end!
abilities.flavorQuote: Try and stop me, I dare you!

abilities.description: Buttercup gains increased defense and tenacity based on her current Rage Stacks. For each Rage Stack, she gains X defense and X tenacity. This passive is constantly active, adjusting dynamically as Rage Stacks are gained or lost.

While charging, she gains damage reduction equal to X. For each Rage Stack, the damage of Ball Blast is increased by X%. Ball Blast deals X physical damage. After casting, she clears all Rage Stacks. This ability has a cooldown of 60 seconds.

Upon reaching 3 Rage Stacks, her evasion chance is increased by an additional X% for the duration of the stacks. Her attacks also have X% chance to ignore enemy defense.

character_v1.playstyle: Buttercup is a bruiser focused on dealing burst damage through Rage Stacks. The kit provides tools to quickly engage enemies and maintain aggression, rewarding consistent offense with increased power.
character_v1.teamSynergy: Buttercup benefits from teammates who can provide crowd control to keep enemies within range of Black Hurricane Strike, or those who can buff her damage output to further amplify her burst potential.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Buttercup's kit synergizes around building and consuming Rage Stacks. Black Hurricane Strike quickly generates stacks, while Green Laser Beam Barrage and Ball Blast consume them for amplified damage. Toughest Fighter's Tenacity provides survivability as she builds Rage.

'Snared' reduces movement speed by 30% and prevents the target from using dash or blink abilities. If Skulker has the 'Containment Module' equipped via Hunter's Arsenal, the trap radius is increased by 20%, and the Snared duration increases to 2 seconds. This ability has a cooldown of 12 seconds. Additionally, enemies hit are afflicted with 'Entangled' for 2 seconds. 'Entangled' reduces attack speed by 20%. If Skulker has the 'Suppression Module' equipped via Hunter's Arsenal, Entangled also reduces magic attack by 20%. This ability has a cooldown of 10 seconds. The cone area widens as Skulker levels up.

Lv100: Improves damage scaling and allies within range are granted a small percentage of Skulker's damage reduction.

aoe damage

abilities.description: Spectral Static—a passive ability that reflects Skulker's aptitude for manipulating ethereal energies. It causes his very presence to emanate a localized field of disruptive energy, clinging to enemies like spectral grime. Specifically, each time Skulker is struck by a melee attack, he passively afflicts the attacker with a stack of 'Static Cling'—an invisible debuff that accumulates until a threshold is reached. Once an enemy accumulates three stacks of 'Static Cling', they are subjected to a brief 'Static Shock'. This shock inflicts a small burst of AoE damage around the afflicted enemy. This field of static is not only an offensive measure but also a defensive one, subtly disrupting incoming projectiles and reducing their impact. In addition, Skulker gains passive damage reduction against ranged attacks, reflecting his resilience in the face of technological assault. The energy manifests visually as flickering green sparks emanating from Skulker's armor, intensifying with each stack of 'Static Cling' applied to an enemy.
abilities.flavorQuote: "Feel that tingle? It's your system crashing."

abilities.name: Ghostly Upgrade 9.9
upgrades: Level 150: Fusion duration extended to 20 seconds, giving you more time to capitalize on Ghostly Upgrade 9.9's enhanced abilities.
Level 180: Overload stun duration increased to 1.5 seconds, giving Skulker's team more time to punish opponents caught in the energy surge.

Level 200: While fused, Skulker gains immunity to crowd control effects, becoming an unstoppable force on the battlefield. If the form is lost prematurely, Skulker gains a 500 + (0.3*X) shield for 5 seconds, mitigating the immediate vulnerability of reverting to base form, where X represents Skulker's current level.
abilities.description: Skulker overrides his ecto-skeleton with Technus' advanced technology, becoming the Ghostly Upgrade 9.9 for 15 seconds. While upgraded, Skulker's raw power surges, granting him 30% bonus HP and a 20% increase to both attack and magic attack, amplifying his combat potential. Every basic attack during this fusion applies a stack of 'Overload' to the target. Once a target accumulates 3 stacks of Overload, they are momentarily stunned for 1 second by the overwhelming energy. Each of Skulker's auto attacks also deals an additional 50 plus (0.1 * X) bonus magic damage, further electrifying the battlefield with each strike, where X represents Skulker's current level. Furthermore, while fused, Skulker's tactical options are enhanced: Spectral Trap Launcher now deploys not one, but three spectral traps in a tight cone, increasing zone denial capabilities. Ecto-Net Barrage's range and cone angle are doubled, effectively ensnaring a wider area in spectral nets. However, this powerful fusion is not without its risks. If Skulker's health plummets below 25% while fused, the form destabilizes, and the upgrade is lost, forcing Skulker to revert to his base form. Ghostly Upgrade 9.9 has a cooldown of 90 seconds.

abilities.name: Tech-Enhanced Tenacity
upgrades: Level 130: Evasion increased to 15%.
Level 170: Each stack of Adaptive Protocols also grants 2% increased healing received from all sources, up to a maximum of 10%.

Level 200: Upon reaching 5 stacks of Adaptive Protocols, Skulker emits a pulse of energy, healing himself and nearby allies for 5% of their maximum health. This heal can only occur once every 10 seconds.
abilities.description: Skulker's cybernetic enhancements and relentless focus grant him resilience and elusive maneuvering. He starts with 25 tenacity, mitigating the duration of incoming crowd control effects, and enjoys a 10% evasion chance, allowing him to nimbly dodge incoming attacks. Each time Skulker successfully inflicts a crowd control effect (such as a stun, snare, or silence) on an enemy, he gains one stack of 'Adaptive Protocols', up to a maximum of five stacks. Each stack of Adaptive Protocols bolsters Skulker's defensive capabilities, granting a 3% damage reduction against all incoming damage sources, capping at a 15% total reduction. This potent combination of tenacity, evasion, and damage reduction significantly increases Skulker's survivability. However, to maintain optimal efficiency, the Adaptive Protocols gradually recalibrate: stacks decay one at a time every 5 seconds, forcing Skulker to consistently apply crowd control to maintain his defensive edge.

character_v1.playstyle: Skulker is a tank who uses his zone control abilities and traps to lock down areas and disrupt enemies, protecting his team. His adaptability through Hunter's Arsenal allows him to tailor his defense.
character_v1.teamSynergy: Skulker synergizes well with damage dealers who can capitalize on his crowd control, and benefits from supports who can keep him alive while he sets up his zones.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Skulker's kit revolves around setting up zones with Spectral Trap Launcher and Ecto-Net Barrage. Hunter's Adaptation allows him to tailor his kit to be more tanky or disruptive. SkulTech 9.9 provides a powerful offensive burst.

character_v1.name: Stan Marsh

abilities.description: Stan, with a barely perceptible sigh, swats forward with surprising force, the brim of his iconic blue-and-red hat striking a single enemy target with undeniable (yet somehow minimal) impact. This deceptively simple attack deals physical damage equivalent to Stan's ATK stat plus a small bonus (0.2x ATK), guaranteed to connect at melee range. The most intriguing aspect is that the target is ever so slightly *annoyed*, gaining a stack of 'Inconvenienced' (max 5 stacks). Each stack reduces the target's damage output by 2% for 3 seconds. Furthermore, each successful Hat Whack grants Stan a stack of 'Mild Confidence', boosting his armor by 1.5% (max 5 stacks, 3 seconds duration). Stan's calm yet resolute stance, honed from countless (and mostly mundane) South Park adventures, provides a small shield absorbing damage equivalent to 5% of Stan's HP for 2 seconds upon cast.

abilities.name: Aw, Awww! The Dude's Exasperation
upgrades: Level 25: Increases the magic damage to X + 8% of Stan's magic attack.
Level 75: Increases the duration of '****ed Up!' to 7 seconds.
Level 125: '****ed Up!' reduces the target's attack damage by 5% per stack.
Level 175: Applies 2 stacks of '****ed Up!' on initial hit.
abilities.description: Stan, with a visible pinching of his nose, unleashes a wave of exasperation targeting the closest enemy. This attack deals magic damage equal to X + 5% of Stan's magic attack and applies 1 stack of '****ed Up!'. Each stack of '****ed Up!' reduces the target's attack damage by 3%, stacking up to 5 times. This effect lasts for 5 seconds. The spell prioritizes enemies who have not yet been affected by '****ed Up!' to ensure broader coverage of debuffs. The cooldown for this ability is 8 seconds, allowing for frequent application of the debuff.

Level 200: Adds a 30% chance to inflict Silence for 2 seconds in addition to the stun, further compounding the enemy's misery.

(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Stan, overwhelmed by the situation, casts a disapproving glare that ripples through the enemy ranks. This focused wave of exasperation deals magic damage equal to X plus 10% of Stan's magic attack to all enemies caught in a medium-range straight line originating from him, with a slight targeting bias toward back-line foes. Simultaneously, the sheer weight of Stan's disappointment inflicts one stack of 'Seriously?' on each affected enemy. Should an enemy already bear five stacks of 'Seriously?', the intensity of Stan's condemnation briefly stuns them for 1 second, interrupting their actions. However, this stun effect will not apply to enemies who are immune to stuns. The ability has a cooldown of 12 seconds, ensuring that the frequency of Stan's profound dissatisfaction is appropriately timed and managed, preventing its overuse while still allowing it to serve as a potent tool for area control and single-target disruption.

abilities.name: Dude, This is Pretty Serious!
upgrades: Level 50: Increases the shield amount to 9% of Stan's max HP.
Level 100: Reduces the internal cooldown to 7 seconds.
Level 150: Increases the shield duration to 6 seconds.
Level 200: Allies also gain 12% increased magic atk for the duration of the shield.
(Balance Patch) Reduced shield potency ~7%.
(Patch) Role realignment: this ability now emphasizes bruiser-style interactions.
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Whenever an enemy succumbs to the weight of 'Pissed Off!' and reaches its maximum of five stacks, Stan, with a newfound sense of urgency and responsibility, channels his concern into a protective wave for his allies. He grants each ally a shield, absorbing damage equal to 6% of Stan's maximum HP for a duration of 4.5 seconds, offering temporary respite from incoming attacks. This shield provides valuable breathing room, allowing allies to reposition, heal, or unleash their own potent abilities without fear of immediate reprisal. Realizing the stakes, Stan also bolsters his own defenses, increasing his Defense by 50, fortifying his position on the front lines. This passive effect can only trigger once every 9.5 seconds, ensuring that the shields remain strategically impactful and prevent their constant spamming, maintaining the balance of the battlefield. The shield represents Stan's innate goodness and desire to safeguard his friends when the situation demands it, reflecting his growth as a character who prioritizes the well-being of his companions above all else.

abilities.name: Dude, This Is Serious!
upgrades: Level 150: Increases the magic damage to X + 20% of Stan's magic attack.
Level 175: Increases the speed buff to 15%.
Level 200: Applies 4 stacks of 'Screwed Up!' instead of 3 and extends speed buff duration to 9 seconds.
(Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~45%).
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
(Patch) Role realignment: this ability now emphasizes jack ofalltrades-style interactions.
abilities.description: When the chips are down, and things get real, Stan doesn't hold back. Upon activation, Stan unleashes a wave of concerned frustration, an iconic outburst triggered by witnessing the utter chaos unfolding around him. This emotionally charged wave washes over all enemies, dealing magic damage equal to X plus 15% of Stan's magic attack, forcing them to face the gravity of the situation. Furthermore, this wave applies 3 stacks of 'Screwed Up!' to each enemy, making them more vulnerable to subsequent attacks and debuffs. In a display of team spirit and concern, Stan simultaneously inspires his allies. All allies gain a 10% increase in speed for 7 seconds, a surge of adrenaline fueled by Stan's plea to get their acts together. The ultimate reaches across the entire battlefield, affecting all enemies regardless of their distance. After the initial burst of action, the ultimate demands a cooldown period of 45 seconds, a testament to the taxing nature of leading by example and dealing with the constant shenanigans of South Park.

abilities.name: Dude, Weak: Stan's Unimpressed Stance

Level 200: Reflected status effects also have their duration extended by 1 second.

abilities.description: Stan, showing his nonchalant attitude, passively increases his and his allies' tenacity by 10. Whenever an enemy attempts to inflict a status effect on Stan or an ally, there is a 20% chance to reflect the effect back onto the attacker, demonstrating Stan's and his allies' resistance to manipulation and control. The reflected effect has the same duration and intensity as the original. This passive embodies Stan's detached and unimpressed demeanor towards external threats. Stan himself gains 15% evasion against damage coming from enemies with 5 stacks of '****ed Up!', further reinforcing his ability to withstand and disrupt enemy advances.

character_v1.playstyle: Stan Marsh is a controller, debilitating enemies with debuffs and reducing their offensive capabilities. His kit revolves around the '****ed Up!' mechanic, lowering enemy damage output and disrupting their strategies, making him a solid enabler.
character_v1.teamSynergy: Stan pairs well with damage dealers who can capitalize on debuffed enemies. His shields and speed buff further enhance team survivability and damage output, making him a versatile support.
character_v1.tierSummary: Stan's controller kit is severely disjointed, lacking cohesive synergy between his debuff application ('Aw, Awww!') and the underwhelming payoff of 'Dude, This is Pretty Serious!'. His reliance on the 'Pissed Off!' status, which is easily cleansed or resisted, renders his control unreliable compared to peers like (hypothetical superior controller). The 'Serious, Dude' stun provides brief respite but suffers from single-target focus in an AoE-centric meta. The passive tenacity buff from 'Dude, Weak' offers minimal team utility, failing to elevate him above bottom-tier characters who provide more immediate and impactful support. 'OH MY GOD, THEY KILLED KENNY!!' ultimate is a desperate attempt at impact, but its delayed execution and reliance on setup makes it too easily countered for reliable comeback potential.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Stan's abilities are designed to apply and capitalize on the '****ed Up!' debuff. 'Aw, Awww! The Dude's Exasperation' and 'Dude, This is Pretty ****ed Up Right Here' apply initial stacks, while his passive shields allies upon full stacks. His Ultimate delivers a potent burst application, synergizing with his evasive signature passive.
